is a character in . Biography Yona is a member of a royal Zora family that resides in a domain outside of Hyrule. During her childhood, she visited Zora's Domain in the Lanayru Great Spring, where she became friends with Sidon. As an adult, she has become Sidon's fiancée, which was arranged by Dorephan. When Yona would visit Zora's Domain as a child, Sidon was initially scared of her due to his fear of strangers, but Yona was more mature and treated him as a younger brother. One day, while Yona and Sidon were playing with the other Zora children, a sudden Rain came and swept them all down the Zora River. Yona was able to pull Sidon to shore, and she comforted him as the River continued to rise toward them. Eventually, the pair were rescued by Sidon's older sister, Mipha, who Yona came to admire.

Yunobo is a recurring character in . Biography Yunobo is a young Goron who lives in Goron City in the Eldin Canyon. He is a descendant of the Champion Daruk, and as a result, he is able to make use of Daruk's Protection. He can also be observed wearing Daruk's ceremonial cloth around his shoulders. Despite being an adult, Yunobo remains immature in many ways, such as his lingering fear of Monsters. He is also known to have an earnest nature, which has led to him becoming naive and gullible. When Divine Beast Vah Rudania reactivated on Death Mountain, Yunobo became Bludo's assistant. Whenever the Divine Beast got too close to crossing Death Caldera, Bludo would launch him towards it with his Cannons, with Yunobo using Daruk's protection to keep himself safe. Oftentimes, Yunobo was spotted by the Divine Beast's Sentries, though Bludo was capable of deflecting the resulting Magma Bombs. However, despite their repeated efforts, Vah Rudania would always return. Prior to Link's arrival in Goron City, Yunobo left for the Abandoned North Mine to retrieve painkillers for Bludo's back, but he has yet to complete his trip. At the start of the "Divine Beast Vah Rudania" Main Quest, Bludo asks Link to send Yunobo back to him should they encounter one another. When Link arrives at the Abandoned North Mine, he will find Yunobo trapped and shouting for help from inside the Vault. Using the Cannon, Link is able to destroy the rocks blocking the Vault's entrance, thereby freeing Yunobo. thumb|left|250px|alt= A screenshot of Yunobo inside the Vault. Text on-screen displays his name, along with the title "Goron Youth".|Yunobo's introduction When Link approaches Yunobo, he will be cowering at the back of the Vault and muttering to himself about what he should do. He then turns around and, fearing that Link is a Monster, begins to panic. After getting to look at Link, however, he realizes that he is actually a Hylian and calms down. He asks Link if he was the one who rescued him and expresses his gratitude for doing so, though he wonders why he is at the Abandoned North Mine in the first place. Once Link reveals that he was looking for him, Yunobo will introduce himself. He explains that while he was fetching Bludo's painkillers, a Magma Bomb caused a rock slide, causing him to become trapped. He remembers that he needs to deliver the painkillers, so he tells Link to see Bludo for a reward. Yunobo then rolls out of the Vault, leaving Link behind. Yunobo is the President of YunoboCo, a company responsible for mining efforts throughout the Eldin Region. Like his ancestor Daruk, Yunobo now wields a Boulder Breaker that he fights with. He is also in possession of a Power of Fire, which is capable of destroying Hard Sediments. He keeps a diary, which is known as Yunobo's Diary. After Divine Beast Vah Rudania was calmed, the Lava throughout the Eldin Canyon cooled. The disappearance of the Scorching Climate caused disagreements and illness amongst the Gorons, and Yunobo was concerned that Goron City would fall apart. Since new sources of Ore were now accessible, Yunobo decided to begin digging. He was joined by several other Gorons, most notably Slergo and Offrak, and so he founded YunoboCo to help revitalize Goron City. Through his company, Yunobo created the new Mountain Road to encourage tourism to Goron City, hoping the visitors would purchase the Ore that they mined at a reduced price. When the Upheaval began, Yunobo planned to leave for Lookout Landing after hearing that Zelda and Link had gone missing. However, he was concerned by the Gloom emanating from Death Mountain, and he wanted to investigate it and ensure Goron City was safe before doing so. At Death Mountain Summit, he met a Phantom Ganon disguised as Zelda, who gave him the Weird Mask. Through this, Yunobo was controlled by the Phantom, and he began distributing Marbled Rock Roast through YunoboCo and mind-controlling the adult Gorons. Yunobo and the Phantom Ganon would regularly meet up to harvest Marbled Rock Roasts from Gloom Rocks together. At one point, she also warned him to stay away from the Lizard Lakes. When the Gorons' addiction to Marbled Rock Roast begins to threaten Goron City, Yunobo dismisses the problem and insists that everything is fine. After he is freed from the control of his Mask by Link, Moragia rises from Death Mountain and Yunobo joins Link to find "Zelda" and stop the spread of Marbled Rock Roast plaguing the Eldin Region. After Link and Yunobo defeat Marbled Gohma at the Fire Temple, Yunobo awakens as the new Sage of Fire. Overview As part of the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest, Purah asks Link to investigate strange happenings caused by the Upheaval throughout Hyrule in an effort to find Princess Zelda. After "Tulin of Rito Village" has been completed, she suggests Link visit Goron City next, since it is closest to their location at Lookout Landing. In Goron City, Link will find that all of the adult Gorons focused on eating Marbled Rock Roasts, ignoring everything else. Bludo, Slergo, and Offrak are standing over Krane, disappointed that he has given into the temptation of Marbled Rock Roast. Slergo and Offrak realize that the Marbled Rock Roast mined by YunoboCo is the cause of the Gorons' altered behavior. , also known as YunoboCo's HQ, is a location in . Features and Overview YunoboCo HQ is the headquarters of the mining corporation YunoboCo, built atop the North Mine in Eldin Canyon. It is connected to Goron City by a line of Rails. A small shop run by Dayto can be found beneath a tower with Yunobo's likeness carved onto it, selling Flamebreaker Armor. A room belonging to Yunobo is located above the store, and can be reached through a series of ladders along the outside of the tower. This room contains his Diary, a Poster depicting a recipe for Hasty Vegetable Curry, and a hole leading down into the store. There is a small cave on the north side of the headquarters known at the YunoboCo Storage, where Yunobo is fought during the "Yunobo of Goron City" Main Quest. Several Gloom Rocks can be found here prior to the quest's completion. Creatures Zonai Devices

The , also known as the Company Store, is a location in . Features and Overview The YunoboCo Mineral Market is situated where the New Road meets the Mountain Road northwest of the Southern Mine in Eldin Canyon. It is manned by Bladon and Shmid, who operate the two YunoboCo Stores inside. They sell Ores at half the price they can be bought for elsewhere. Pieces of Ruins Rubble commonly fall onto the site from the Eldin Sky Archipelago above. Prior to the completion of "Yunobo of Goron City", Bladon will not be present at his YunoboCo Store, meaning Link will be unable to purchase Rubies from him. After the Marbled Rock Roasts disappear, he returns to his stand, and he dedicates himself to selling Rubies once again. Areas Creatures

, also known as YunoboCo's Stores, are Shops in . Features and Overview YunoboCo Stores are Shops established by YunoboCo throughout Eldin Canyon. A total of four YunoboCo Stores can be found, two at the YunoboCo Mineral Market and two in Goron City. Since they source their Ores and Gems directly from YunoboCo, they are able to sell them at half the price they would normally be sold for. This is part of Yunobo's goal to make Ores more accessible to tourists from outside Eldin Canyon. Aji's Shop Aji's YunoboCo Store sells Sapphires, and it is located in Goron City. Wares and Pricing Bladon's Shop Bladon's YunoboCo Store is located at the YunoboCo Mineral Market. Initially, his shop will be unmanned, meaning Link will be unable to purchase his Rubies. After the "Yunobo of Goron City" Main Quest has been completed, Bladon will return to his Shop and resume selling. Wares and Pricing Gonguron's Shop Gonguron's YunoboCo Store is located in Goron City and sells Diamonds. He recommends Fusing Diamonds to Shields. Wares and Pricing Shmid's Shop Shmid's YunoboCo Store, which specializes in Flint, is part of the YunoboCo Mineral Market. Wares and Pricing

Zanmik Shrine, designated by the trial name Scoop It Out, is a Shrine of Light in . Entrance to the Shrine thumb|right|320px|alt= The ramp sitting above the wheel.|The interior of the Shrine Zanmik Shrine is located within Hateno Village in East Necluda. It corresponds to the Kimnaz Lightroot in the Depths. It sits above Uma's House on the east end of the Village. Themes and Navigation thumb|right|320px|alt= Link using Ultrahand on a Metal Plate to bridge a circuit.|Link connecting the circuit with Ultrahand Zanmik Shrine opens into a large chamber leading to a Concave Slot on the floor and a portcullis which leads to the end of the Shrine. Beside the Concave Slot, there is a rounded ramp leading upward over a hole in the floor. This hole contains a separate level where a wheel on a spoke can be found. Beneath this wheel, there is a pit full of Ancient Orbs. Five Metal Plates can be found near this pit, and these can be used to connect a nearby Electricity Generator to an outlet which powers the wheel's spoke. By connecting this power source, the wheel will begin to slowly spin toward the entrance of the Shrine. In order to transfer an Ancient Orb to the Concave Slot above, Link can merge an Ancient Orb onto the wheel with Ultrahand and allow it to carry the Orb to the ramp. The ramp will then disconnect the Orb, creating an opportunity for the Orb to roll downward into the Concave Slot. Link can alternatively create a scoop by merging together the Metal Plates to achieve the same effect. Once an Orb has entered the Slot, the portcullis will permanently rise, allowing Link to reach the end of the Shrine. A Rauru and Sonia Statue can be found at the end of Zanmik Shrine. By interacting with the Terminal in front of the Statue, Link can receive a Light of Blessing to cleanse the corruption of Darkness from within him.

, also known as the Usurper King's Helmet, is a recurring Item in . Location and Uses Zant's Helmet is a piece of Armor introduced in the "EX Treasure: Usurper King" Side Quest from The Champions' Ballad Downloadable Content pack. It is a priceless relic that was once kept safely within the walls of Hyrule Castle, but was later stolen by Misko. Misko hints at the whereabouts of Zant's Helmet in Misko's EX Journal 2 in the Deya Village Ruins, claiming that it rests among dead Trees in Tobio's Hollow. The Hidden Chest containing Zant's Helmet can be found between two dead Trees in the middle of a Bottomless Bog in Tobio's Hollow. In order to retrieve it, Link must use the Magnesis Rune to pull it from the ground. When worn, Zant's Helmet grants Link the Unfreezable bonus, preventing Link from being frozen. However, Link will still take damage from exposure to frigid environments and freezing water even while wearing Zant's Helmet. It cannot be enhanced by a Great Fairy, nor can it be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop in Hateno Village. Zant's Helmet is said to be much like the Helmet that Zant wore in the Era of Twilight. After initially finding Zant's Helmet, Link can purchase more from Granté in Tarrey Town for 50 Rupees. Zant's Helmet is located in a Gloom-cloaked Treasure Chest in the Scorching Coliseum. It cannot be retrieved unless all of the Enemies inside the Coliseum have been defeated. The location of Zant's Helmet is revealed by an Old Map found in the South Lanayru Sky Archipelago. Zant's Helmet can be retrieved without first finding the Old Map, however. After it has been found in the Scorching Coliseum, it can also be purchased from a Bargainer Statue for 400 Poes. Other Appearances right In , Zant's Helmets are Gold Materials that can be dropped by Zant upon defeat. In , Agitha and Medli can use Zant's Helmet to create various Badges in the Badge Market. In , only Agitha can use Zant's Helmet in the Badge Market. Zant's Helmet can also be used to create various mixtures in the Apothecary.

is a Well in . Features and Overview Zelda's Secret Well is located behind Princess Zelda's House in Hateno Village, which is part of East Necluda. While the Well was being dug, a hidden room that was once part of the House was discovered. Zelda had Bolson refurbish the room, and although it is Dark, it has a stable Temperature and humidity. Zelda would utilize the room below the Well when she needed to work by herself and concentrate. A wooden platform is built over a portion of the Water-filled area and contains simple furnishings, and several Brightblooms are used to emit Light. Zelda's Diary can be found on a small Desk surrounded by various Books and scrolls. An adjacent board has colorful drawings of Hateno Village, Zelda, a Hateno Cow, and Hateno School. If Link reads Zelda's Diary, he discovers that Zelda prepared the Champion's Leathers as a gift for him, and she hid them in Hyrule Castle's Throne Room. This starts the Side Quest "A New Champion's Tunic". Creatures Materials Treasure Chests

are recurring Items and Objects in . Location and Uses Zonai Devices are unique Materials that were created by the Zonai. They have a variety of effects intended to assist with movement throughout the Sky, though they can also be Fused with equipment for combat or used to construct Vehicles with Ultrahand. Many Zonai Devices require power from an Energy Cell to function; all Zonai Devices that require power feature a circular yellow power symbol on the body of the Device. Some Zonai Devices are single-use while other Zonai Devices that do not use Energy Cells to function will expire over use. Zonai Devices will flash light-green before they expire this way. Various Sub-Bosses have attacks capable of destroying nearby Zonai Devices. For example, a Lynel's roar will cause Zonai Devices to instantly break. Zonai Devices can be obtained from Device Dispensers, and from Supply Sites in the Depths. List of Zonai Devices Other Appearances The Zonai Devices that appear in can be either seen as Objects or obtained as Items in . As Items, Warriors are capable of collecting Zonai Devices and using them as Special Actions during Battles. While a Zonai Device is active, it will continuously expend Energy. The only exception to this is the Battery, which cannot be used as a Special Action. Instead, Batteries are capable of recharging the Energy Gauge. The Knight Construct and Mineru are both able to assign Zonai Devices to use during their Strong Attacks. As Objects, Zonai Devices can be seen in a variety of locations. For example, several can be seen around Camps. Mineru makes use of Zonai Devices alongside other pieces of Zonai Technology as part of her attacks with the Royal Mace. List of Zonai Devices

are a recurring type of location in . Features and Overview Zonai Ruins are the overgrown remains of Zonai civilization from an unknown era. They are present all throughout Hyrule, though they are most concentrated in the Faron Grasslands and the southern portion of Necluda. However, several Ruins are also present in Akkala, Central Hyrule, Gerudo, and Hebra. Several of these Ruins have been built in conjunction with Ancient Hylian Ruins, such as the Spring of Courage, or Ancient Shrines created by the Sheikah. Their architecture features a distinct swirl pattern, which is emblematic of the Zonai themselves. Many Zonai Ruin statues depict Dragons, owls, and Boars. The most prevalent type of Zonai Ruins are Zonai Towers, spreading as far north as Central Hyrule and Hebra. Though their purpose is unknown, rumors state that the Zonai may have used them for magic. In southern Necluda, several of the Stone Statues that mark Food Offerings are replaced by Zonai Ruin statues. List of Zonai Ruins Zonai Ruins are the primary feature of the following locations: Other Zonai Ruins, including Zonai Towers, are present at the following locations: When the Sky Islands appeared at the beginning of the Upheaval, a large number of Zonai Ruins were revealed. Many of them fell to the Surface of Hyrule, though a large number of Ruins remain in the Sky. List of Zonai Ruins Coliseums Factories Labyrinths Mines Ring Ruins

The are a recurring location in . Features and Overview The Zonai Ruins are situated in the depths of the Faron Woods, in the heart of the Faron Grasslands. A road heading out from Pagos Woods crosses the Floria River via a low wooden bridge, heading towards the ruins, before turning off towards the southeast and on through the steamy sea of trees. Passing through on occasion on this road with his Donkey, on his trek to hock his wares from Lurelin Village, is Chumin. Meeshy, an adventurer, and Totsuna, a dragon-enthusiast, can also be found travelling on this road. Found northeast across the Floria River, two tall, carven stone pillars mark the ruins' exact location. Near the base of the western pillar is a large stone dragon statue, resting near some crumbling stone facade, completely covered in green moss. Between the two pillars, a large, tall, wooden Monster Stronghold can be found, hosting several Bokoblins. There are also several Wooden Boxes, wrapped in banana leaves, on two of the encampment's levelled platforms. To the north, an Electric Wizzrobe frolics in a green clearing. In the clearing are two metal Crates, which can be manipulated with the Magnesis Rune. On the ground are square stone pavers and a worn dirt path, which denotes an ancient road no longer marked on any map. This old path heads north through the clearing before veering off to the northwest. This path is marked by another stone dragon statue, which lies between Harker Lake and the aforementioned clearing, and whose stone head points in the direction of the Damel Forest. These ancient ruins are thought to be the home of a mysterious tribe of barbarians known as the Zonai, who vanished long ago. The Zonai Ruins mark only the entrance to a much larger ruin complex, which spans from its start at the Floria River, through the Damel Forest, and up to the Spring of Courage. It appears to follow the winding, serpentine flow of the Dracozu River. At the aforementioned Monster Stronghold, at the very top of the wooden structure, is a Wooden Chest containing a Sapphire. West of the ruins, on top of a small hill, is a small cave blocked with a breakable rock wall. Inside are four Ore Deposits. East of the ruins' pillars, through the woods, is a small pond teeming with fish. Above this is a tall hill with a long fish-filled lake, bordered with some trees and much vegetation. It's fed by a small waterfall from the east, and along this lake's western shore is a rocky overhang where several Rushroom can be picked. Up on this latter hill, hiding amidst the vegetation—and appearing only at night—is a single Blupee. Creatures Enemies Materials

are a mechanic in . Overview The Zonau Respawn is a mechanic that mirrors the Blood Moon, causing Soldier Constructs, Captain Constructs, and Flux Constructs to respawn when certain conditions are met. Unlike the Blood Moon, the existence of the Zonau Respawn is not communicated to the player beyond the respawn effect. Due to the differences between the two of them, the Zonau Respawn and the Blood Moon can quickly become desynchronized from each other as a playthrough progresses, despite both their timers beginning at the same time. Once Link begins the Main Quest "The Closed Door", a timer will begin in the background. This timer counts up during "un-paused" gameplay until it reaches 144 minutes, or 6 in-game days. On the midnight after the timer reaches 144 minutes, the Zonau Respawn will be queued for activation. If Link has not unlocked the Surface layer of the Map, then the Zonau Respawn will not be queued until the midnight after he does so. Once Link "changes maps" by Warping or by entering or exiting a Shrine of Light, the Zonau Respawn will activate and all defeated Construct Enemies that are eligible to respawn will do so. Loading a save file or restarting the game will not trigger the respawn effect.

, also known as the Land of the Zoras, is a recurring location in . It is based on Zora's Waterfall from . It serves as the home of the aquatic race known as the Zora. Features and Overview In , Zora's Domain is located in the northeast section of Hyrule and is home to King Zora and his daughter, Princess Ruto. It consists of a large cavernous area mostly filled with water, with a large waterfall flowing from the top into the lower area. Its source of water comes from Zora's Fountain, to which it is closely linked. The only ways to access the domain are from Zora's River or via a secret entrance hidden underwater in Lake Hylia; however, only those who have some connection with the Royal Family of Hyrule are allowed to enter. To enter via Zora's River, Link will need to play "Zelda's Lullaby" in front of the seemingly impassable waterfall at the end of the river to prove his connection to the Royal Family. This will cause the waterfall to momentarily split in two, allowing the young hero to access Zora's Domain. Link's first visit to the domain is called upon during his search for the third Spiritual Stone, the Zora's Sapphire. He ventures Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly in Zora's Fountain to rescue Princess Ruto, receiving the Spiritual Stone in return. Seven years later, after Link awakens from having pulled the Master Sword from its pedestal, the young hero returns to Zora's Domain to find it completely frozen over. Moreover, the entrance to Lake Hylia has been blocked by ice. The only Zoras that inhabit it are King Zora and the shopkeeper of the Zora Shop, and both of them are frozen over by Red Ice, which only Blue Fire can melt. Sheik explains that the ice is caused by an evil curse, and the source of the curse is Morpha, a monster in the Water Temple. The only way to restore Zora's Domain to its natural state is by destroying Morpha. Thus, Link ventures to the Water Temple where, with the aid of Princess Ruto, the source of the curse is shut off. Princess Ruto, awakening as the Sage of Water, thanks to Link for his help and reassures him that Zora's Domain and its people will eventually return to their original state. During the ending credits, Zora's Domain is shown to have been thawed out, although it is still empty since all of the Zoras are in Lon Lon Ranch celebrating the defeat of Ganondorf. Travelers entering the area by foot cross the Great Zora Bridge over Ruto Lake. There, they are greeted with a view of a large stone Fish surmounting the Domain, which represents Lord Jabu-Jabu. Unlike other towns in the game, Zora's Domain consists of a single extensive structure instead of separate buildings. Its design include a number of curving bridges and open spaces, which are often bounded by colonnades instead of walls. The Domain's structure includes large quantities of Luminous Stone, which causes several portions of it to glow softly during the night. These structures are maintained by two Zora artisans, Fronk and Ledo, apprenticed under Dento. Upkeep of the Domain requires the use of large quantities of Luminous Stone. The Great Zora Bridge opens into the Zora's Domain Square, which is centered around Mipha's Statue. The far side of the plaza is bounded by the central structure of the Domain. The central opening in the wall leads down a short flight of stairs to a pool containing Fleet-Lotus Seeds and Bright-Eyed Crabs. The Ne'ez Yohma Shrine is found in the center of this pool. To the sides of this opening are a shopping center, Marot Mart, and the Seabed Inn. A pair of stairways on the outer sides of these buildings lead to the Domain's second floor, where a large roofed area contains the Sleeping Chamber. Two further flights of stairs lead to the royal Throne Room on the third level. Between the steps to the Throne Room is the Domain's Goddess Statue, where Link can exchange four Spirit Orbs for either a Heart Container or a Stamina Vessel. Below Zora's Domain are several small islands within a large lake, though a Ladder can be used to return to the entrance. 10,000 years ago, Zora's Domain was founded after the Zora moved to Lanayru, which was due to the pure Water that could be found there. The Ore in the Region also inspired the Domain's architecture. However, the Rain that plagued Lanayru every 10 years would sweep away the Zora who lived there, resulting in the construction of the East Reservoir Lake in order to contain the Water. When Ancient Technology was banished from Hyrule, Divine Beast Vah Ruta was hidden at Zora's Domain, where it would be found again centuries later. In the present, the Domain is ruled by King Dorephan, with Sidon as his heir. Aside from their princess Mipha, who was piloting Divine Beast Vah Ruta, Zora's Domain suffered no casualties as a result of the Great Calamity. is a recurring location in . Zora's Domain Square goes unnamed in . Features and Overview Zora's Domain Square is located in the center of Zora's Domain. Zora Armors, also known as Zora Tunics, are recurring Items in . Location and Uses In , the Zora Tunic allows Link to breathe underwater. It is mostly used in conjunction with the Iron Boots and is essential when exploring the Water Temple. Unlike the Goron Tunic, it does not offer any defense bonuses. The Tunic can be stolen by a Like Like if Link is still wearing it when he gets spit out. The Tunic can be bought at the Zora Shop for 300 Rupees, or it can be given to Link by the King Zora when he unfreezes him from the Red Ice using Blue Fire. The Zora Tunic is made out of fish gills, although aesthetically it looks completely identical to the other tunics in the game, with color being the only difference. The Zora supplied several Zora Tunics in service of the King of Hyrule's Hylian water inspectors to help them clean the bed of Zora's River. In , the Zora Armor is given to Link by Rutela after delivering Ralis to Kakariko Village safely. It is located behind the Kakariko Village Graveyard under the tomb of the King Zora, its creator. When equipped, the Zora Armor allows Link to breathe and swim underwater. If combined with the Iron Boots, Link can walk deep on riverbeds. However, wearing the armor makes Link take 10 times the damage from Fire and Ice attacks. (Including falling in Lava or freezing Water) The Zora Armor itself is made of Zora scales in a scale mail arrangement, and includes a mask that Link pulls over his face while underwater. In , the Zora Armor was hand crafted specifically for Link as a symbol of love by the Zora princess and Champion, Mipha. Link receives it from King Dorephan 100 years later when first visiting Zora's Domain. If Link's pouch is full, he will receive it after making space in the inventory. When worn, the Zora Armor provides one level of Swim Speed Up and grants Link the ability to Swim Upward through waterfalls. The Armor can be enhanced by a Great Fairy and can be Dyed at the Kochi Dye Shop. The Zora Armor, alongside the Zora Helm and the Zora Greaves, compose the Zora Set. When each piece of the Set has been enhanced at least two times by a Great Fairy and the full Set is worn, it provides a Swim Dash Stamina Up Set Bonus. Unlike most armor, however, this Set cannot be sold due to the Armor's unique story behind it. The Armor itself consists of a large full breastplate, a set of scale mail covering the shoulders and part of Link's back, two pauldrons made from steel, and bracers made from a combination of silver and steel plates. , also known as , are recurring Items in . Location and Uses Silver Bows are Bows that were originally made for fishing, and because of this, they do not bear high attack power. However, they do have a higher durability due to the special metal they're crafted from. They belong to the Zora Gear equipment archetype, which includes Weapons created by the Zora. Commonly, they are found in the Lanayru Great Spring, particularly around Zora's Domain, as well as in the Akkala Highlands. Many Lizalfos in these areas utilize them. Being made of metal, Silver Bows will conduct Electricity and attract Lightning if they are equipped during a Thunderstorm. They will also sink if they are dropped in Water, but they can be picked up with the Magnesis Rune on the Sheikah Slate. Finally, Silver Bows will not burn if they are exposed to Fire or a Scorching Climate.

, also known as , is a recurring location in the . It is one of the main bodies of water in Hyrule, with its water source being either Zora's Domain or Zora's Fountain. Features and Overview In , water from the Zora's River flows from Zora's Fountain, which serves as the water source of all Hyrule. While the region known as Zora River consists of a region of the river to the east, the river itself continues throughout Hyrule Field. Eventually, the water of Zora's River reaches Lake Hylia, passing through Gerudo Valley in the process. At the northern section of the river is the Sleepless Waterfall, a seemingly impassable waterfall that protects the entrance to Zora's Domain. Zora's River is accessible either by Hyrule Field or through an underwater portal located in the Lost Woods. A few bridges are built over the river for easy traversing. Its waters, however, are infested with monsters. On the way to the Sleepless Waterfall is a group of frogs collectively known as the Fabulous Five Froggish Tenors, although they disappear when Link returns to the river seven years later. Enemies portrays Zora's River in possibly its largest incarnation thus far. The water from Zora's River comes from the throne room in Zora's Domain. It flows down to a section known as the Upper Zora's River, and from there the water splits into three branches. One branch flows into north Hyrule Field, and the other two wind down through an area known as the Rapids Ride. The latter branches serve as the water source for Lake Hylia, which is where the river ends. However, these parts of the river are not accessible by foot and can only be reached by canoe or by riding a Kargarok. Due to its immense length, the river serves as the location of two mini-games: Iza's Rapid Ride and Fruit Pop Flight Challenge. Going against the rapids involves Fruit Pop Flight Challenge, using a Kargarok for flight. Going downstream involves traversing the Rapid Ride in a kayak (similar to the one used in Lure Fishing). When Link as a wolf first visits the Lanayru Province while it is covered in Twilight, he finds out that the Zora's River has dried up since Zora's Domain has completely frozen over. As such, Lake Hylia has dried up as well, threatening the lifestyle of the Zora people and impeding them from returning upstream. To get to Zora's Domain, Link has to ride a Shadow Kargarok through the dried-up river. Upon reaching Upper Zora's River, Link will discover that the Zoras' entire domain has frozen over, and it is not until Midna Warps a Molten Shard from Death Mountain into the Zoras' throne room that the ice will melt and the water will begin to flow again. Later, he must travel to Upper Zora's River by Shadow Kargarok a second time to defeat the Shadow Insects along the route and obtain their Tear of Light. Areas In , Zora River begins at

throne room that the ice will melt and the water will begin to flow again. Later, he must travel to Upper Zora's River by Shadow Kargarok a second time to defeat the Shadow Insects along the route and obtain their Tear of Light. Areas In , Zora River begins at the southern part of Ruto Lake, and it flows throughout the Lanayru Great Spring through several Waterfalls. Inogo Bridge, Oren Bridge, and Luto's Crossing all cross over Zora River, connecting parts of the road leading to Zora's Domain. At its end, the Zora River empties out into the Lanayru Wetlands. 10,000 years prior to , during the Era of Prosperity, Zora's Domain was constructed over the Zora River due to its abundance of fresh Water. However, the Zora River would flood every 10 years due to heavy Rain in Lanayru, which would damage the Domain and wash away the Zora who lived there. The king of the Zora reached out to the King of Hyrule for assistance, which resulted in the construction of the East Reservoir Lake. After Mipha perished during the second Great Calamity, the Zora attempted to send her Lightscale Trident down the Zora River to set her soul to rest. When they did so, however, the Lightscale Trident began to glow, and Mipha's voice could be heard telling them to abandon their grief and focus on remembering her. As a result of this, the Champion Festival is celebrated on the anniversary of the Great Calamity. Shortly before Link awoke from his Slumber of Restoration, Divine Beast Vah Ruta reactivated in the East Reservoir Lake and began endlessly generating Water. The amount of Rain caused by this has threatened to overflow the East Reservoir Lake, which would flood both the Zora River and the Hylian settlements downstream. Due to King Dorephan's fears, Sidon left Zora's Domain in search of a Hylian to help them face Divine Beast Vah Ruta. During the "Reach Zora's Domain" Main Quest, Link is tasked with following the Zora River up the path to Zora's Domain. At the same time, Sidon will be swimming up the River, and he will call out to Link from that Water at several points in their journey. There are legends that if someone sends a letter down the Zora River from the Bank of Wishes, the person who responds to them will be their true love. Finley has been following this legend by setting her Love Letters adrift in the River, from which she has received replies from Sasan. However, her mother Kodah has forbidden her from doing so due to Divine Beast Vah Ruta's rampage. After the "Divine Beast Vah Ruta" Main Quest has been completed, Finley will ask Link to watch her Love Letter as it floats down the Zora River so she can find out who has been replying to her. Agreeing to do this activates the "Special Delivery" Side Quest. As Link follows the Love Letter down Zora River, he will have to keep

will ask Link to watch her Love Letter as it floats down the Zora River so she can find out who has been replying to her. Agreeing to do this activates the "Special Delivery" Side Quest. As Link follows the Love Letter down Zora River, he will have to keep it safe from Monsters. It will also get caught along fences or in outcroppings, requiring Link to set it back on its course. After it reaches the end of the Zora River, it will drift towards Sasan's campsite at its mouth. Many Treasure Chests can be found floating or submerged within the Zora River. In total, these Chests contain one Silver Rupee, one Opal, one Zora Spear, one Silver Bow, five Arrows, 10 Ice Arrows, and one Bomb Arrow. In Master Mode, several wooden platforms carried by Sky Octoroks can be found along the Zora River. It is believed that true masters of these Shields can redirect attacks like a rock redirecting rushing water. Silver Shields belong to the Zora Gear equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by the Zora. There are five scattered across Hyrule Kingdom, a majority of which are in the Lanayru Great Spring and in and around Lake Hylia. An additional two are stowed away in Treasure Chests in Master Mode. They are found at the following locations: The west bridge of Zora's Domain Within a Treasure Chest underneath the throne room of Zora's Domain Inside a Treasure Chest in the middle of Lake Akkala, off the west side of Dah Hesho Shrine In a wooden Treasure Chest at the southeast shore of Lake Hylia, north of the lone Tree. A Treasure Chest just off the west coast of Eventide Island Silver Shields are made of metal, and will therefore conduct Electricity and attract Lightning if they are equipped during Thunderstorms. They also will not burn when exposed to Fire or a Scorching Climate like wooden Shields. Though they sink in water, they can be picked up and manipulated with the Magnesis Rune. Zora Shields reappear in Other Appearances Zora Shields can be wielded by Link in conjunction with Zora Swords.

Zora Spears are recurring Items in . Location and Uses Zora Spears are used by Zora warriors. They appear to be made of carved Coral, and their grips are decorated with bead work. Zora Spears are a type of Weapon made by the Zora, crafted from a specific type of metal that makes them particularly light for their size. They belong to the equipment archetype known as Zora Gear. Despite their limited damage output, they are used by the Zora for protecting themselves and for fishing. They are used by the female guards of Zora's Domain, Dunma, Gaddison, and Torfeau. Lizalfos in the Lanayru Great Spring and Lake Hylia also use them. The Series Mipha amiibo has a chance to spawn a Treasure Chest containing a Zora Spear when it is scanned with the amiibo Rune. Dento requires a Zora Spear to recreate both of his special Weapon crafts at the Hammerhead. If Link wants a new Ceremonial Trident, Dento will ask for a Zora Spear and five pieces of Flint to make a new one. The same recipe is required for remaking the Lightscale Trident, with the addition of a single Diamond. Zora Spears are made out of metal, so they will not burn when exposed to Fire or a Scorching Climate. However, they will sink if they are dropped in Water. Zora Spears will also conduct Electricity and attract Lightning during Thunderstorms, and they can be picked up using the Magnesis Rune. Other Appearances

are recurring Items in . Location and Uses Zora Swords are one-handed Weapons fashioned by the Zora. These Swords belong to the Zora Gear equipment archetype. They are forged from a type of durable and rust-resistant metal and ornamented with traditional Zora designs. The metal they are constructed from is known to be durable and rust-proof. They are commonly found within East Necluda and the Lanayru Great Spring, particularly in and around Zora's Domain. Zora Swords are made of metal, and therefore they do not burn when exposed to Fire or a Scorching Climate. They do, however, conduct Lightning if they are equipped during Thunderstorms, and they also conduct Electricity. If they are dropped in the Water, they will sink, but they can be picked up using the Magnesis Rune. Other Appearances An ancient version of the Zora Sword appears in , which is wielded by Zora Soldiers. They are One-Handed Weapons, and one is carried by Lago as his default Weapon. The Knight Construct is also able to fight with Zora Swords.

is a recurring character in . Biography Zorona is a traveler who can be found riding his Horse along the shore near Zelo Pond in Eldin Canyon. He is a self-proclaimed mystery buff, and is curious about the mysteries in the areas nearby. However, Zorona is much more curious about the rumors of the Fang and Bone shop, and has been desperately trying to learn more about it. He deduces that its location is at the Skull Lake north of Death Mountain, but also mentions that it has been spotted in other places too. Zorona also mentions other mysteries that he has heard or claims to have solved. He claims that there is legendary equipment found in Hyrule Castle and Korok Forest. He also claims to have found evidence of hidden Koroks. Zorona now travels with Kairo. According to Zorona, Kairo had such a bad sense of direction that it inspired him to travel with him. This works out well for the two of them, as Zorona is also a terrible cook and can rely on Kairo. Link can watch as Scorpis gives directions to Zorona and Kairo and then meet up with them as they travel from Lookout Landing to Riverside Stable, to next to a Tree on the path between Wetland Stable and Kakariko Village, and finally to just outside Gerudo Town.

is a recurring character in . Biography Zumi can always be found at Serenne Stable, either next to the Cooking Pot outside or next to Akrah, Onya, and Garshon in the rain. When talked to in the afternoon, she tells Link that he must be tired from his trip and wonders if he is a leviathan researcher. Late at night, she is glad to see link Link because she thinks traveling on dark roads is dangerous. Regardless of the time, she mentions ruins behind Mount Drena that are always dark, and says that no one who goes there ever returns. As a result, she warns Link and advises him to stay away from the ruins. If it is raining, she mentions how dreadful the weather is and that all she can do is relax in the stable. Zumi is found in front of New Serenne Stable near a broken wagon. She states she's busy and refers Link to Sprinn at the counter. If asked what she's up to, she'll explain how she found a broken-down Wagon and wants to restore it to use for herself. This starts the Side Quest, "Horse-Drawn Dreams." If Link asks about building materials, Zumi will direct him to a stash of unused materials. If he asks about wild Horses, she'll explain how you can register a Horse if you catch one in the wild, but also comments on how it's a difficult task to catch one. If Link attaches one of the two missing wheels to the Wagon, or attaches both wheels incorrectly, Zumi will thank him but explain that it still won't roll correctly. If Link attaches both wheels correctly, Zumi will thank him and state that all she needs now is a wild Horse to complete her dream. If Link then brings her a wild Horse, she'll ask if Link caught it for her. If he refuses to give the horse to her, she'll state how she wishes to be able to catch Horses like Link can. If he gives the horse to her, she'll express her surprise and gratitude for the gift. She'll attach a Towing Harness to the Horse and explain how they work. After helping her out, Zumi will reward Link with a Silver Rupee, and also name her wagon after a combination of her and Link's names. If spoken to afterwards, she shares her knowledge of Horses with Link. She deems rainy weather as awful and waits it out under the New Serenne Stable Well's roof.

is a recurring character in . Biography Link can find Zyle standing near a Cooking Pot in the Gerudo Canyon. Link can speak to Zyle to begin the "Good-Sized Horse" Side Quest. Zyle is surprised to see Link and tells him that he was attacked by monsters, causing his Horse to run away and leaving him stranded. Zyle asks Link to sell him a Horse for 300 Rupees if he finds one for him so that he may continue his travels. Link agrees to find him a Horse and Zyle's only request is that the Horse is not too big but "suitably sized." Upon returning to Zyle with a Horse, Zyle is excited that the Horse is just like his old one and asks if he could have it for 300 Rupees. Link agrees to sell the Horse and Zyle pays him 300 Rupees as promised. Before departing, Zyle expresses excitement about his new partner and the Side Quest is completed. If Link talks to Zyle as he departs on his new Horse, he tells Link to say hello to him if he ever sees him on his travels. After this point, Zyle can be found at the Outskirt Stable in Hyrule Field. Zyle is now a Wandering Merchant. He can be found traveling between New Serenne Stable and Snowfield Stable. Wares and Pricing

White Horse is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. The Hyrulean royal family that perished 100 years ago would sometimes ride atop white horses as a display of their divine right. This white horse may be a descendant of one once ridden by royalty.

Giant Horse is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This giant horse is the last of its kind. Its physical capabilities completely overshadow those of regular horses, but its temperament is extremely wild. Only a truly skilled rider can train, or even catch, this beast of a mount. This is a horse that chooses its rider.

Horse is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These can most often be found on plains. Their usefulness as transportation has made them valuable since ancient times. That said, wild horses do tend to get spooked and run off when approached, so if you're looking to snag one, it's best to sneak up on it. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Faron Grasslands.

Red Sparrow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These small birds live in the Hebra region and eat mainly nuts and wild plants. Their bright-red feathers are often used as decorations. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Hyrule Ridge. It drops: chickaloo tree nut.

Wood Pigeon is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These pigeons inhabit vast regions all throughout Hyrule, so they can often be found in forests, grasslands, or even villages. They don't have a very strong sense of awareness, so even less-skilled hunters can nab them pretty easily. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Hyrule Field. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Accented Pigeon is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. The original variety of wood pigeon, these small birds once were seen all around Hyrule but are quite rare these days. Their color often serves as camouflage. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, East Gerudo Sky Archipelago. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Hearty Bass is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This large fish lives near the shoreline. Its sizable body can store a lot of nutrients. When cooked into a dish, it will temporarily increase your maximum hearts. It can be found in: Tabantha Sky Archipelago, West Hebra Sky Archipelago.

Hearty Salmon is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This fish makes its home in cold water, giving it extra layers of fat. It temporarily increases your maximum hearts when used in cooking. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier.

Stalhorse is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This skeletal horse is ridden by monsters. It was once a regular horse, but Ganon's power revived it from death. It cannot maintain its bone structure in the daytime. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Akkala Highlands.

Donkey is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. Smaller than horses, these are raised as livestock in the countryside, so they don't exist in the wild. They're more powerful than they look and specialize in transporting baggage. This has made them popular with traveling merchants. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule.

Red-Tusked Boar is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These boars are known for their red tusks and black fur. They're similar to your average boars but are considerably stronger. Extra caution is advised when hunting these. It can be found in: Akkala Highlands, Hyrule Ridge. It drops: raw prime meat.

Bubbulfrog is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These mysterious creatures dwell in caves all around the world. They like to stay hidden and will spew bubbles when threatened. When overcome, they disappear and leave behind mysterious objects. It drops: bubbul gem.

Blue Sparrow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This breed of sparrow is most often seen in the Lanayru region. They get most of their food from leaves and plants that grow near water. If it's safe enough, they can be spotted bathing in puddles or shallow rivers. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, East Necluda. It drops: chickaloo tree nut.

Sand Sparrow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This desert-dwelling breed of sparrow has adapted to withstand the heat in the arid climate of the Gerudo region. Sometimes they can be spotted half-buried in the sand, holding perfectly still as a means of evading predators. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert. It drops: chickaloo tree nut.

Hotfeather Pigeon is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare breed of pigeon lives near Death Mountain. Their fireproof feathers are valuable as clothing material. Their meat, on the other hand, is not fireproof, and it'll burn up as soon as it's struck. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Eldin Sky Archipelago. It drops: raw bird thigh.

Cloud Seagull is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This seagull subspecies dwells mostly at high altitudes and is rarely seen on the surface, although one can occasionally be glimpsed through the clouds. They excel at catching updrafts and gliding around the sky, rarely flapping their wings. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, North Necluda Sky Archipelago. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Cucco is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. Villages often raise these birds for their eggs, but some people actually keep them as pets. They can't fly, but can flap their wings mighty furiously if picked up. They're usually calm creatures, but if you're persistent in your torment of them... Well... It can be found in: West Necluda, Hyrule Field. It drops: bird egg.

Mighty Carp is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This freshwater fish lives alongside its less mighty carp ilk. A compound in its liver promotes muscle growth. Dishes cooked with it will temporarily increase your attack power. It can be found in: Akkala Highlands, Lanayru Great Spring.

Hateno Cow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. Originating in Hateno Village, these cows are kept as livestock primarily for their milk. Their horns are smaller than a water buffalo's, and they're much more docile and therefore easier to raise. Their horns are decorated with bright colors when taken out to pasture. It can be found in: Hateno Village, Lurelin Village.

Highland Sheep is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. Originally native to the mountainous regions, these sheep were domesticated for their wool and have since found a home in villages. Once the fluffy wool grows out, it's harvested and used to make clothing and bedding. They're calm, timid creatures and move about in small herds. It can be found in: East Necluda, Akkala Highlands.

Snowcoat Fox is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This particular breed of grassland fox makes its home in cold climates such as the Tabantha region. Its fur turned white as a means of adapting to snowy weather, serving as natural camouflage. Because of this, spotting one in the snow takes a keen eye. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat.

Maraudo Wolf is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These wolves are not only carnivorous but can also be downright fierce. They're highly aggressive and aren't afraid to attack people. They hunt in groups and surround their prey as a means of bringing it down. That said, if one of their own is injured, the rest are wise enough to run away. They communicate via howls, so if you're wandering the forest and hear their call, you had best take care. It can be found in: Tabantha Frontier, Eldin Canyon. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat.

Wasteland Coyote is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This contentious beast is native to the Gerudo region. It makes its home in the desert, so it doesn't have a problem with hot, arid climates. They do hunt other beasts and small animals but more often turn their sights on people. They're a threat to anyone traveling through the desert. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Highlands. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat.

Cold-Footed Wolf is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This breed of maraudo wolf lives in snowy, mountainous areas, such as the Hebra Mountains. They travel in packs similar to their maraudo relatives but are considerably tougher thanks to having adapted to their harsh environment. They're made even more dangerous by their white fur, which provides a natural camouflage in the snow. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Gerudo Highlands. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat.

Honeyvore Bear is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This king among animals is dangerous game for even the most seasoned hunters. They'll attack anyone who wanders into their territory regardless of the wanderer's weaponry. As their name implies, they have a natural love of honey. Extreme caution is advised when you spot one, but if you're sneaky enough and maybe just a little bit crazy... you just may be able to ride one. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, West Necluda. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat, courser bee honey.

Golden Sparrow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This breed of sparrow is native to the Eldin region. Their down is resistant to burning, an evolutionary trait produced by the harsh volcanic environment. They subsist on small insects that hide inside rocks. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Eldin Canyon. It drops: chickaloo tree nut.

Rainbow Pigeon is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This breed of pigeon is well known for its vivid feathers. They live mainly in the northern forests and grasslands of Hyrule. They're most fond of nuts and grain but won't pass up the occasional insect or earthworm if offered. Their meat is of a higher quality than typical wood pigeon's. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Akkala Highlands. It drops: raw bird thigh.

White Pigeon is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This white-feathered breed of pigeon lives in the Hebra region. It's said that a wood pigeon survived atop a snowy mountain by changing its colors to blend in with the snow and soon after became a white pigeon. They have an extra layer of fat to guard against the cold, so they have been known to yield high-quality meat. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Gerudo Highlands. It drops: raw bird thigh, raw whole bird.

Mountain Crow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This bird is known for its cleverness and for its distinct claws. They make their homes in the mountains, forests, and villages alike. Not only are their jet-black feathers seen as an ill omen, but they'll steal crops right out of a farmer's hands if given the chance. Because of this, they're often met with enmity. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Great Hyrule Forest. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Sand Seal is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These seals use their large flippers to move through the sand as if swimming. They were once wild animals but have since been domesticated by the Gerudo. They rely on their excellent hearing to find their way while riding submerged in the sand.Their large, distinct tusks look pretty ferocious, but their favorite food is actually fruit. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.

Golden Horse is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. An extremely rare horse with a golden coat, said to appear only once every hundred years. The horse's exquisite appearance belies a rugged constitution that makes it adaptable to harsh environments. Highly alert, and picky about who may ride it. Few riders could ever hope to tame this horse.

Bushy-Tailed Squirrel is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These small creatures are known for their large tails. They tend to live in forests and subsist on acorns and other nuts. They carry their food in their mouths but will sometimes drop it when surprised in an adorable display of shock. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge. It drops: acorn.

Mountain Buck is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These male deer are usually found deep in the forest. They're well known for their huge, branching antlers, which they'll swing in self-defense if threatened. Deer are cautious by nature so it can be tricky getting close, but if you can capture one, you may be able to take it for a ride. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Lanayru. It drops: raw prime meat.

Grizzlemaw Bear is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This breed of honeyvore bear is distinguished by its gray fur. Even more ferocious than their relatives, they're commonly believed to be the most dangerous wild animal. They live in deep snow away from villages, so it's uncommon to encounter one. That said, if you do find one, you'd be better off not picking a fight with it. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Gerudo Highlands. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat, hearty salmon.

Rainbow Sparrow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These small birds hail from the Faron region. As the name suggests, their feathers are more colorful than other sparrows', which has made them a favorite among dilettantes. They feed on small rain-forest insects, but the omnivore in them loves nuts as well. It can be found in: Faron Grasslands, East Necluda. It drops: chickaloo tree nut.

Pink Heron is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This breed of Heron is characterized by the pink tips of its feathers. Unlike its waterfront-dwelling relative the blue-winged heron, these live in grasslands or arid regions and subsist on insects that live in the grass. They can often be found walking about searching for food but will fly away if they sense danger. It can be found in: Central Hyrule Sky, Hyrule Field. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Seagull is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These birds live near the ocean. They eat mainly fish, so a flock of seagulls hovering over water is a good indication of where there are fish. Fisherman use this to their advantage when searching for a catch of their own. It can be found in: Necluda Sea, Lanayru Sea. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Staminoka Bass is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This Hyrule bass got to be the biggest fish by never getting caught (until now). Its long life results in a cooked dish that will restore a lot of stamina. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda.

Woodland Boar is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These medium-sized beasts can be found all throughout Hyrule. you can most often find them foraging for food in forests or meadows. Although usually docile, they won't hesitate to charge you full force if you get too close. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda. It drops: raw meat.

Grassland Fox is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This breed of fox is common to grasslands and forests and is hallmarked by its fluffy, white-tipped tail. Unlike other foxes, they tend to act independently rather than form packs. Being omnivores, they hunt animals smaller than themselves and often stick to eating fruit and insects. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Lanayru Great Spring. It drops: raw meat.

Dondon is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A new species of four-legged beast found in southern regions. So far only five of these creatures have ever been spotted in Hyrule. Their diet is a mystery. But what is known is that they are easily scared, and their giant horns can be very dangerous.

Blupee is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. They may look like mere rabbits at a fleeting glance, but these strange and aptly named creatures glow with a mysterious blue light. While the details of their origins are entirely unknown, there is one thing we do know: these peculiar little things have a penchant for collecting rupees.

Common Sparrow is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. As the name suggests, these birds are rather common around Hyrule. They mainly live in the plains or forests but sometimes venture out to villages. Their diet consists of nuts and small insects. They look pretty cute when they jump around, but they don't have much love for people. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Hyrule Ridge. It drops: chickaloo tree nut.

Bright-Chested Duck is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These birds can be found on waterfronts all over Hyrule. Their webbed feet make them excellent swimmers, and their long necks allow them to duck their heads underwater to find food. Their fatty meat is high quality. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Hyrule Field. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Forest Ostrich is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. Flightless birds that are thought to have roamed all over Hyrule back when it had more grasslands. They resist cold but don't do well in hot climates because of their thick body covering. They're very alert and often turn their attention from the grass to look around. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, South Lanayru Sky Archipelago. It drops: raw meat.

Hyrule Bass is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. An ordinary fish that can be found all over Hyrule. It can be eaten raw, but cooking it amplifies its healing benefits. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda.

Voltfin Trout is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This trout makes its home in the freshwater lakes. Its scales have an insulating compound that, when cooked into a dish, offers resistance to electricity. It can be found in: Tabantha Frontier, Hyrule Ridge.

Stealthfin Trout is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. Consuming the bioluminescent compound that makes this fish glow in the dark will increase concentration. Dishes cooked with it will suppress noise when consumed. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, Eldin Mountains.

White Goat is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These goats are raised for their multiple uses. Their milk can be drank or made into butter, and their soft fur is used to make clothes. Domesticated goats wear bells around their necks so they can easily be found after being let out to graze. It can be found in: East Necluda, Hyrule Ridge.

Giant White Stallion is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This massive animal is thought to share its lineage with the white horses ridden by Hylian royalty. Called a "giant white stallion" due to its color and enormous size. This horse is believed to have been the result of a sudden mutation. There are many travelers and researchers keen to seek out this extraordinary creature.

Mountain Goat is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These herbivores make their home in meadows and rocky areas. Their characteristically strong legs and hooves facilitate easy climbing over rocks. Goats aren't very quick, so they make good targets for beginning hunters. It can be found in: East Necluda, Great Hyrule Forest. It drops: raw meat.

Patricia is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This is Riju's own sand seal. It may look intense, but she dotes on it regularly; the ribbon it wears was a gift form her, and it even has its own pen in Gerudo Town. It's far more agile than any other sand seal and far more outgoing. An ever-reliable partner to Riju, Patricia is always ready to take off through the desert at a moment's notice. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.

Water Buffalo is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These wild cows come equipped with big, strong horns. They live off grass that grows near the waterfront. Their meat is considered to be high quality, so they're a common target among hunters. Fun Fact: the domesticated Hateno cow, often raised in villages, was bred through selective breeding using these. It can be found in: Lanayru Wetlands, Hyrule Ridge. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat.

Tabantha Moose is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. The largest breed of deer in Hyrule, this mammal's origin was traced back to the Tabantha region. It's easily distinguished by its immense antlers, which these moose shed and regrow yearly. Their meat is tender and high quality, so it works well in a stew. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Tundra. It drops: raw prime meat, raw gourmet meat.

Hylian Retriever is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. The native breed of this mammal varies by region, but on thing remains true: this animals has been known as "man's best friend" since ancient times. They're very clever and obedient, so aside from serving as pets, they are also put to work watching over grazing livestock. It's said that all Hylian retrievers are descendants of the dog once owned by the king of Hyrule. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Eldin Ostrich is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This large bird makes its home in the volcanic region of Eldin. Their heat-resistant feathers and skin are evolutionary traits produced by the harsh environment. Their wings are too small to facilitate flight, but their long legs make them pretty speedy runners. It can be found in: Death Mountain, Eldin Mountains. It drops: raw bird thigh, raw whole bird.

Sizzlefin Trout is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This red trout prefers warm bodies of water. It has a special organ specifically for storing heat. When cooked into a dish, it will temporarily increase your resistance to the cold. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Hebra Mountains.

Ancient Arowana is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A lively fish that hasn't changed much since ancient times. Its nutritious meat can restore a bit of health. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, North Tabantha Sky Archipelago.

Blue-Winged Heron is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These birds live on waterfronts all throughout Hyrule. Their characteristically thin legs and long necks help them catch water-dwelling fish or frogs for food. They lie perfectly still in wait for their prey and then stretch out their long necks to capture their meal. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Lanayru Wetlands. It drops: raw bird drumstick.

Islander Hawk is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These carnivorous birds live in plains or highlands. They use their sharp talons and beaks to catch and eat small animals and other birds. They soar calmly through the sky and search for prey from above. It can be found in: Gerudo Canyon, Hyrule Ridge. It drops: raw bird thigh.

Sanke Carp is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This wild armored carp has been bred into a prizewinning fish. Its beautifully colored markings do not occur in nature. It offers no special effects when cooked. It can be found in: Kakariko Village.

Mountain Doe is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These female deer are often found alongside a male. They're very timid animals by nature, but they tend to let their guard down when eating apples, a favorite food. This tidbit of information can be useful to hunters. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Lanayru. It drops: raw prime meat.

Chillfin Trout is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This blue trout prefers cold bodies of water. Its skin contains enzymes that keep its body cool, and when cooked into a dish, it will temporarily boost your heat resistance. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Lanayru Great Spring.

Armored Carp is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. Calcium deposits in the scales of this ancient fish make them as hard as armor. Cooking it into a dish will fortify your bones, temporarily increasing your defense. It can be found in: East Necluda, Lanayru Great Spring.
Restless Cricket is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A very energetic cricket. Cook it with monster parts to create a stamina-recovery elixir. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, East Necluda.

Sneaky River Snail is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This large, glow-in-the-dark snail lives in fresh water. When cooked into a dish, it heightens your senses so you can move about silently. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Zora's Domain.

Sticky Lizard is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. The suction of its toes allows this lizard to easily cling to walls. It could be an asset for a climber on wet surfaces if it were mixed into an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves.

Sunset Firefly is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. These fireflies glow gently in the dark. When cooked with monster parts, the compound that causes it to glow results in an elixir that will allow you to move more quietly. It can be found in: Faron Grasslands, East Necluda.

Razorclaw Crab is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This crab is well known for its exceptionally sharp pincers. When cooked, the strength compound in its claws will increase your attack power. It can be found in: Lanayru Sea, Necluda Sea.

Bright-Eyed Crab is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This crab appears in large numbers when it rains. Once bite of its delectable meat, and you'll forget all your exhaustion. Replenishes your stamina when cooked into a dish. It can be found in: Lanayru Wetlands, Eldin Great Spring.

Winterwing Butterfly is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. The powdery scales of this butterfly's wings cool the air around it. Watching it flutter around snowflakes is a thing of beauty. Cook it with monster parts for a heat-resistant elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Mount Lanayru.

Smotherwing Butterfly is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare butterfly lives in volcanic regions. Its body contains a heat-resistant liquid, which can be turned into a topical elixir that offers resistance to flames. It can be found in: Death Mountain, Eldin Canyon.

Bladed Rhino Beetle is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This beetle's razor-sharp horns demand that you handle it with care. Boil the horns alongside monster parts to concoct an elixir that will raise your attack power. It can be found in: West Necluda, East Necluda.

Energetic Rhino Beetle is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This valuable beetle can live up to ten years. When cooked with monster parts, its impressive vitality translates into an elixir that will greatly restore your stamina. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, West Necluda.

Mighty Porgy is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This ocean-dwelling fish comes with one rude attitude. The compounds in its flesh elevate your competitive spirit when it's cooked into a dish, thus increasing your attack power. It can be found in: Faron Sea, Necluda Sea.

Ironshell Crab is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This crab's shell is particularly hard. When cooked into dish, its fat and meat bolster the body to increase your defense. It can be found in: Necluda Sea, Faron Necluda.

Fairy is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This fairy will fly from your pouch and heal all your wounds the moment you lose your last heart. It's easily mistaken for a firefly at first, but it glows in the daylight as well as night. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves, Hyrule Sky Islands.

Summerwing Butterfly is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A butterfly found in the woods and plains of warm regions. Its wings absorb the warmth of the sun. Cook it with monster parts to create an elixir that makes you feel warm and fuzzy. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Gerudo Highlands.

Thunderwing Butterfly is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare butterfly only shows itself when it rains. The organs in its body produce an insulating compound. When made into an elixir, it offers electrical resistance. It can be found in: Thunderhead Isles, Faron Grasslands.

Deep Firefly is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A multi-winged insect that lives in the Depths. It excretes luminescent elements that can be cooked into an elixir, which will add a faint glow to anyone who consumes it. It can be found in: Great Abandoned Central Mine, Lanayru Wetland Depths.

Electric Darner is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare dragonfly only appears in the rain. Its wings direct electricity away from its body. Cook it with monster parts for an electricity-resistance elixir. It can be found in: Thunderhead Isles, West Necluda.

Rugged Rhino Beetle is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This beetle's hard body resembles armor. When the shell is cooked with monster parts, the resulting elixir boosts your defense. It can be found in: West Necluda, East Necluda.

Cold Darner is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This dragonfly prefers the cool shade of trees to the warmth of the sun. Its wings disperse heat from its body, which can be cooked into a heat-resistance elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Mount Lanayru.
Glowing Cave Fish is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A luminous fish that lives in dark caves. When consumed, its light enzyme can make one's body glow. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves.

Armored Porgy is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This porgy's body is covered in armor-hard scales. The compounds in its scales, when cooked into a dish, fortify your bones and temporarily boost your defense. It can be found in: Necluda Sea, Lanayru Sea.

Warm Darner is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This dragonfly has a special organ that causes it to sweat profusely. Cook it with monster parts for an elixir that will raise your core temperature so you can resist the cold. It can be found in: Akkala Highlands, Faron Grasslands.

Hot-Footed Frog is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A quick frog that can be found hopping around near water. Cook it with monster parts to draw out its speed-boost effect. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, East Necluda.

Sticky Frog is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This frog likes to cling to walls and hang out. It oozes a substance that climbers can use to cling to wet surfaces. It can be found in: West Necluda, Lanayru Great Spring.

Fireproof Lizard is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare lizard can only be found in the Eldin region. Its scales have heat-resistant properties, so when cooked with monster parts it produces a heat-resistance elixir. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Eldin Mountains.

Tireless Frog is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare frog only ventures out in the rain. When cooked with monster parts, the elixir it produces will temporarily increase your maximum stamina. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Zora River.

Hightail Lizard is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. A lizard found throughout Hyrule. It's a but slow to react at times, but it given a chance to escape, it will dart off quickly. Cook it with monster parts for a speed-boosting elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge.

Hearty Lizard is a Creature in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare lizard lives deep in the forests. It feeds on high-nutrient foods, giving it great vitality. When used to make elixirs, they temporarily increase your maximum hearts. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, East Necluda.

Tree Branch is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Wooden branches such as this are pretty common, but it's surprisingly well-balanced. It doesn't do much damage, but can serve as a weapon in a pinch. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Hyrule Field.

Boomerang is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A decayed wooden boomerang. A useful tool that comes back after you throw it. Its current state has not lessened its performance. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Lanayru Wetlands.

Soldier'S Broadsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A light, thin metal sword used by the guards of Hyrule Castle. Its light weight makes it easy to handle and enables quicker charged attacks. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Gerudo Scimitar (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The most commonly used sword in the Gerudo region. Attaching a material greatly enhances the material's power but doesn't add as much durability.
Boomerang (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This throwing weapon was originally used by the forest-dwelling Koroks. Its unique shape allows it to return after being thrown.
Knight'S Broadsword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Knights of Hyrule Castle once carried this sword. It can yield powerful attacks when you're down to your last heart.

Royal Broadsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A sword gifted to accomplished knights by the royal family. Crafted for sword masters, it increases the power of flurry rush during perfect dodge. It can be found in: Hyrule Castle, Gerudo Highlands Depths.

Forest Dweller'S Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A living, wooden Korok sword with a decayed blade. Bursting materials attached to the tip can be reused again and again. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Great Hyrule Forest.
Feathered Edge is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A double-edged Rito sword with a decayed blade. Swinging it produces a strong wind. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier.
Mighty Zonaite Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A powerful sword used by Zonai and made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to greatly increase its attack power.

Boat Oar is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Made for paddling boats, but it was made sturdy enough to fight strong currents. Maybe it's useful for self-defense in a pinch. It can be found in: East Necluda.

Traveler'S Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A basic two-handed sword once wielded by aspiring adventurers. It's decayed and no longer cuts well, but it can still knock a shield right out of enemies' hands. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Desert.

Soldier'S Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A lightweight metal weapon forged for royal soldiers. It's decayed now, but still easy to wield, so it consumes less stamina during charge attacks. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Soup Ladle is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A kitchen implement often used for serving delicious soups. It was carved from the wood of a sturdy tree, so it actually packs quite the wallop. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda.
Traveler'S Sword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A very common sword often kept by travelers to fend off small beasts. It's fairly durable but a bit unreliable against monsters.

Feathered Edge (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Rito craftsmen forged this lightweight, double- edged sword so Rito warriors could maneuver quickly in midair. Swinging it produces a strong wind.

Lizal Boomerang is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A curved sword favored by the Lizalfos. It's made of metal so it can safely be used near fire. If you throw it, it will return to you. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Mount Lanayru.

Gloom Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This slender sword has an ominous presence. It is said to end the life of anyone it touches. Its gloom will gradually wear down the body of its wielder.

Farming Hoe is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A farming tool primarily used for tilling fields. Its fine craftsmanship is sturdy enough to withstand backbreaking fieldwork, but its battle applications are untested. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda.

Knight'S Claymore (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Only the strongest of Hyrule Castle's knights carried this two-handed sword. It can yield powerful attacks when you're down to your last heart.

Royal Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A large sword, now decayed, issued to the royal family's guard. It's tuned for skilled users and yields a powerful flurry rush during a perfect dodge. It can be found in: Great Plateau, Hyrule Castle.

Royal Claymore (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A two-handed sword issued to the Hyrulean royal family's immediate guard detail. Yields a powerful strike and increases the power of flurry rush during perfect dodge.

Cobble Crusher (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Goron-made two-handed weapon. It's made from thick, hard metal and has no cutting edge, but its weight and hard surface make it a great tool for breaking rocks.

Eightfold Longblade (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A single-edged sword seldom seen in Hyrule. This weapon is passed down through the Sheikah tribe. When wielded by a proficient fighter, it cleaves wind and creates vacuum.

Royal Broadsword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The Hyrulean royal family would award this sword to knights who achieved remarkable feats. It increases the power of flurry rush during a perfect dodge.
