Forest Dweller'S Sword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Koroks crafted this wooden sword for Hylians. It might not be the best choice for head-on attacks, but bursting materials attached to the tip can be reused again and again. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Great Hyrule Forest.

Rusty Broadsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This once-fearsome sword has seen better days. It can do some damage in the right hands but also breaks quickly. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda Depths.

Royal Guard'S Sword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A weapon made by the Sheikah using ancient technology. Its low durability is a downside, but it yields massive destructive power just before it breaks.

Sturdy Wooden Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A stick made out of a hard tree branch. The tree soaked up lots of sunshine, so it's sturdier than a regular stick and has high durability. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Strong Zonaite Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A strong Zonai sword made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to increase some of its attack power. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, Thunderhead Isles.

Magic Rod is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A small and intensely magic rod, it's said to have been wielded by an ancient magician who awoke maximum latent power in gems. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, West Necluda.

Biggoron'S Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A legendary greatsword forged by a Goron craftsman for a hero who traveled through time. The exceptionally sharp cutting edge is a testament to the craftsman's mastery.

Soldier'S Broadsword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A sword brandished by soldiers who once protected Hyrule Castle. Its blade is well tuned for slaying monsters as it enables quicker charged attacks.

Knight'S Broadsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Knights of Hyrule once carried this sword. Even in its decayed state, it shows its true resolve in desperation and can yield powerful attacks when you're down to your last heart. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Hyrule Castle.
Zora Sword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A unique sword with a thin blade of Zora design that yields high attack power when wet. This blade takes to water like a Zora.

Gerudo Scimitar is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A decaying scimitar from the Gerudo region, it is designed for maximizing force. Attaching a material greatly enhances the material's power but doesn't add as much durability. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.
Wooden Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A tree branch with an added grip and excellent balance. Equip it, and use it as a weapon. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Bokoblin Arm is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A skeletal arm that keeps moving even after it's severed from its body. It's kind of gross to strap it to your back, but it'll do in a pinch. It's old and fragile, so it's quick to break. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, Gerudo Desert Depths.
Soldier'S Claymore (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. An improved claymore, made lightweight for easier handling. It consumes less stamina for charged attacks.

Zora Longsword (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A longsword made by the Zora using a special metal. It's rarely used because the Zora prefer to use spears. It yields high attack power when it gets wet.

Eightfold Blade is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A single-edged sword of the Sheikah tribe. Its small blade, now decayed, is suited for covert actions and yields more powerful sneakstrikes than ordinary blades. It can be found in: Hyrule Field.

Giant Boomerang (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This massive boomerang requires two hands. Originally used for hunting, it was modified for use as a weapon. The blades on the inner curves make it a bit tricky to wield.

Zora Longsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A decayed Zora longsword, it's suited for battles near water because it's made of an unusual metal that increases attack power when it's wet. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring.

Eightfold Longblade is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A longblade that no longer cuts as well as it once did, due to its decayed edge. However, when wielded by a proficient fighter, it cleaves the wind and creates a vacuum. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Gerudo Highlands.

Sword Of The Hero is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A sword once wielded by a hero in an ancient age. When it's grasped, a strange sense of nostalgia washes over you. Take it when going alone would otherwise be dangerous.

White Sword Of The Sky is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A sword said to have once belonged to a hero from the sky. Its beautiful white blade stands out. When it's wielded, a strange yet heavenly breeze kicks up around you.

Gnarled Wooden Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A very swingable stick made by honing a dried branch to the proper thickness and length. Its attack power is much greater than that of a normal stick. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Mount Lanayru.

Cobble Crusher is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. In its former state, this hefty weapon knocked out many a foe. Decayed, it still packs a punch and is great for breaking rocks. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Eldin Canyon Depths.

Gerudo Claymore (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Only the most talented Gerudo sword fighters carry this two-handed sword. Attaching a material greatly enhances the material's power but doesn't add as much durability.

Master Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The legendary sword that seals the darkness. Its corruption was healed by its time with the Light Dragon. The blade gleams with a sacred luster that can oppose the Demon King.

Torch is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This torch will stay lit once ignited, but if you put it away, the flame will be extinguished until you light it again. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Desert.

Traveler'S Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. An average sword used largely by travelers. The blade has decayed, but it can still serve its purpose. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Zora Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A long Zora sword with a decaying blade. Made of a metal favored by the Zora, it yields a high attack power when it gets wet. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring.

Scimitar Of The Seven is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A famous sword once beloved by the Gerudo Champion Urbosa. It is said that when Urbosa swung this sword in battle, her movements resembled a beautiful dance. It can be found in: Gerudo Town.

Royal Guard'S Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A prototypical sword for knights. Its metal may not be as durable as others, but the sword yields massive destructive power just before it breaks.

Zonaite Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Zonai sword made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to slightly increase its attack power. It can be found in: Necluda Sky Archipelago, South Eldin Sky Archipelago.

Lizalfos Arm is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The arm of a Stalizalfos that continues to struggle even in death. It can be used as a weapon, but it's very brittle. You can feel it wiggling when you strap it to your back... It can be found in: Greater Hyrule.

Giant Boomerang is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A massive boomerang that is weathered and decayed. It was originally used for hunting, but it can be a challenge to wield. Thrown well, it will come back to the thrower. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Traveler'S Claymore (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A basic two-handed sword once wielded by aspiring adventurers. Its immense weight can knock enemies' shields right out of their hands.

Knight'S Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A claymore, now decayed, once carried by knights of Hyrule. It resonates with the desire to protect at all costs and can yield powerful attacks when you're down to your last heart. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Desert.

Boulder Breaker is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This two-handed weapon was once wielded by the Goron Champion Daruk. Daruk made swinging it around look easy, but a Hylian would need an immense amount of strength. It can be found in: Goron City.
Sea-Breeze Boomerang is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A boomerang said to have been used by a hero who traveled the Great Sea. It smells faintly of salt water.

Eightfold Blade (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A single-edged sword traditional to the Sheikah tribe. It just may be among the sharpest conventional weapons ever made. It can yield more powerful sneakstrikes.

Gerudo Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A two-handed Gerudo sword with a decayed blade. Attaching a material greatly enhances the material's power but doesn't add as much durability. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Highlands.

Fierce Deity Sword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A peculiar greatsword allegedly used by a hero from a world in which the moon threatened to fall. It slashes wildly in battle as if possessed by a Fierce Deity.

Royal Guard'S Claymore (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The Sheikah used the very essence of ancient technology to forge this greatsword. It's low in durability, but its magic yields massive destructive power just before it breaks.

Royal Guard'S Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A prototype spear wielded by knights. It's made from a special metal with low durability, but which yields massive destructive power just before it breaks.

Long Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A long stick fashioned from a tree branch. Its straight shape makes it work well as a lunging weapon. It can be found in: Tabantha Frontier, Hebra Mountains.

Wooden Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This wooden bow may not be the most reliable for battling monsters, but it is excellent for hunting small animals. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, South Lanayru Sky Archipelago.

Forest Dweller'S Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The Koroks made this bow for Hylians. It's crafted from flexible wood and uses sturdy vines for the bowstring. Its construction may be simple, but it fires multiple arrows at once. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest.

Falcon Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A highly refined Rito-made bow created by a master Rito craftsman. Rito warriors favor it for its superior rate of fire, which helps them excel even further at aerial combat. It can be found in: Tabantha Frontier, Hebra Mountains.

Boko Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A basic Bokoblin bow made of wood. It's made by taking any tree branch and just tying a string to either end, so don't expect much in the way of combat effectiveness. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Strong Zonaite Longsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A strong, large sword used by the Zonai and made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to increase some of its attack power. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, Thunderhead Isles.

Royal Halberd is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Although now decayed, this spear was once given to knights who guarded critical areas of Hyrule Castle. It enables a powerful flurry rush during a perfect dodge. It can be found in: Hyrule Castle, East Necluda.

Zonaite Longsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A large sword used by the Zonai and made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to slightly increase its attack power. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, Necluda Sky Archipelago.

Zora Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Zora spear with a decayed point. It's made of a water-resistant metal and yields a high attack power when it gets wet. It can be found in: Lanayru Wetlands, Upland Zorana.

Gnarled Long Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A long stick made bumpy at one end when its shoots were cut off. It has higher attack power than a normal stick. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.

Knight'S Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The sturdy metal construction of this bow offers superior durability, while its lack of firing quirks makes it quite reliable. Once favored by the knights at Hyrule Castle. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Akkala Highlands.

Royal Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. In the past, the king of Hyrule presented this bow to only the most talented archers in the land. Its combat capabilities are as impressive as its extravagant design. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Gerudo Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This Gerudo-made bow is popular for the fine ornamentations along its limbs. Designed for hunting and warfare alike, this bow was engineered to strike distant targets. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Highlands.

Royal Guard'S Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This prototype Sheikah-made bow was designed to fight the Great Calamity. Made with ancient technology, it boasts a high rate of fire and firepower but has low durability.

Dusk Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A bow that's been in the royal family for ages. Said to have been used by a princess who fought beasts of twilight. It forcefully fires long-range arrows.

Mighty Zonaite Longsword is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A powerful, large sword used by Zonai and made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to greatly increase its attack power.

Magic Scepter is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A long and mysterious magical rod, it's said to have been wielded by an ancient magician who awoke the latent power of gems. It can be found in: Central Hyrule Depths, Mount Lanayru Depths.

Moblin Arm is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Moblin bone that continues to move even after being detached from its body. The bone is thick enough to be used as a weapon but is extremely brittle and easily broken. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, Deep Akkala Depths.

Throwing Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A specialized spear weighted to excel as a throwing weapon. It's perfectly balanced to be thrown farther than your average spear, able to pierce targets from a great distance.

Sturdy Long Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A long, durable stick made from a branch with good piercing power. It has high durability because it comes from the hardest part of the tree. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, East Necluda Depths.

Zonaite Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Zonai spear made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to slightly increase its attack power. It can be found in: Rising Island Chain, Lanayru Sky Archipelago.
Arrow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A common arrow. Its shaft was carved from the wood of a sturdy tree. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule.

Traveler'S Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A small bow used by travelers for protection. It doesn't do a lot of damage, but it can be used to attack foes from a distance. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Forest Dweller'S Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Korok spear with a decayed tip. It's still full of vitality. Bursting materials attached to the spearhead can be reused again and again. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest.

Feathered Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A spear used by Rito soldiers, its point is now decayed. It still boasts quick attacks in midair, and it produces a strong wind. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier.

Gloom Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A spear whose ominous appearance strikes fear into hearts. It is said to cost its bearer a part of their soul because its gloom will gradually wear down the body of its wielder.

Soldier'S Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A bow designed for armed conflict. Inflicts more damage than a civilian bow, but it will still burn if it touches fire. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hebra Mountains.

Swallow Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This bow is a favorite among Rito warriors. The bowstring has been specially engineered for aerial combat, which allows it to be drawn faster than a normal bow. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier.

Thick Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A stick cut off from a large tree. It isn't very sturdy, but its heavier end can swat a shield away. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hebra Mountains.
Dusk Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A slender claymore thought to have been handed down to the kingdom of Hyrule ages ago. The blade shines with a holy luster.

Rusty Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A two-handed sword not properly cared for. Although it can be used as a weapon, its durability is very low. Don't expect it to last for more than a few strikes. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon Depths.

Gnarled Thick Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A stick cut from a tree trunk. It's been dried to increase its hardness. It has high attack power for something made of wood. It can be found in: East Necluda, Gerudo Highlands.

Fishing Harpoon is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A fisherman's tool that excels at catching large fish. Its particularly sharp spearhead makes it valuable as a weapon as well. It can be found in: Lurelin Village.

Throwing Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A spear for throwing with a decayed tip. Lost its sharpness, but kept the balance perfect for throwing, enabling you to throw it very far. It can be found in: Central Hyrule Depths.
Soldier'S Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A long spear once used by the guards of Hyrule Castle. Easy to use but difficult to master. Enables quicker charged attacks.

Feathered Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Its lightweight design is a hallmark of Rito craftsmanship. It gives Rito warriors more maneuverability during aerial combat—and it produces a strong wind.

Gerudo Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Gerudo spear with a decayed blade that is designed to draw force to its tip. Attaching a material greatly enhances the material's power but doesn't add as much durability. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.

Strong Zonaite Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A tough spear used by the Zonai. It is highly durable. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to increase some of its attack power. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago.

Phrenic Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A bow passed down through the Sheikah tribe. Concentrating before drawing the string will allow you to target distant enemies as easily as those nearby. It can be found in: East Necluda, West Necluda.

Sturdy Thick Stick is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A solid stick cut from the crooked branch of a tough tree. It has high durability, despite the way it looks. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Desert.

Gloom Club is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A metal stick filled with madness and symbolic of doom. Its forceful strike can smash an object to pieces. Its gloom will gradually wear down the body of its wielder.
Traveler'S Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A spear used mainly by travelers to fend off wolves and other beasts. It's easy to hold and simple to use.

Knight'S Halberd is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Now decayed, this halberd was made for knights of Hyrule. It reflects their courage in defending the kingdom. It can yield powerful attacks when you're down to your last heart. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Faron Grasslands.
Mighty Zonaite Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A powerful Zonai spear made of zonaite. It resonates with attached Zonai devices to greatly increase its attack power.
Old Wooden Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A wooden bow from the olden days. It's built for hunting, but it's not very powerful. It can be found in: Great Sky Island.

Zora Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A bow favored by the Zora for fishing. It doesn't boast the highest firepower, but the special metal it's crafted from prioritizes durability. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring.

Royal Guard'S Claymore is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A decayed claymore prototype for the royal guard. It's made of a metal refined using an unusual method, and it holds massive destructive power just before it breaks.

Wooden Mop is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Just a mop to the untrained eye, it excels at tidying up the place. But it owes its sturdy construction to a true craftsman, so it actually has some combat merit. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Farmer'S Pitchfork is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A farming tool used to collect hay efficiently. It's light enough to be used by anyone. The four prongs are very sharp. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda.

Traveler'S Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. An average spear carried by travelers for protection. It's decayed and doesn't cut well, but the shape makes it easy for anyone to handle. It can be found in: Death Mountain, Gerudo Highlands.

Knight'S Halberd (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A spear used by knights adept in mounted combat. The spearhead is modeled after an axe. It can yield powerful attacks when you're down to your last heart.
Royal Halberd (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This spear was issued to the knights who guarded Hyrule Castle's throne room. It yields a powerful flurry rush during a perfect dodge.

Zora Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This spear is a Zora's weapon of choice. It's made from a special metal and is used by the Zora for both fishing and protecting home. It yields high attack power when it gets wet.

Lightscale Trident is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A spear of peerless grace cherished by the Zora Champion Mipha. Although Mipha specialized in healing abilities, her spearmanship was in a class all its own. It can be found in: Zora's Domain.

Gerudo Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This spear was used widely by the Gerudo soldiers. Attaching a material greatly enhances the material's power but doesn't add as much durability.

Magic Staff is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A long rod with a bit of magic, it's said to have been wielded by an ancient magician who awoke the latent power of gems. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, North Gerudo Sky Archipelago.

Great Eagle Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A bow without equal wielded by the Rito Champion, Revali. It's said Revali could loose arrows with the speed of a gale, making him supreme in aerial combat. It can be found in: Rito Village.

Soldier'S Spear is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Although now decayed, this lightweight metal spear was made for royal soldiers. Because it's light and easy to handle, it enables quicker charged attacks. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Forest Dweller'S Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The Koroks made this spear for Hylians. The shaft is made from a light, sturdy wood. Bursting materials attached to the spearhead can be reused again and again.

Rusty Halberd is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A rusty polearm likely used by knights from an age past. The spearhead is in bad shape due to prolonged exposure to the elements, so its durability is low. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Royal Guard'S Spear (New) is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This Sheikah-made spear was created using ancient technology. It has poor durability, but the magic it contains yields massive destructive power just before it breaks.

Hylian Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield passed down through the Hyrulean royal family, along with the legend of the hero who wielded it. Its defensive capabilities and durability outshine all other shields.

Spiked Boko Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. An upgraded Boko bow bound with animal bone to boost its durability and firepower. Its craftsmanship is sloppy, but it's light and easy to use. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Highlands Depths.

Pot Lid is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The lid of a large soup pot. It smells vaguely of poultry broth... Yum! It can take quite a beating before breaking. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Royal Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield issued to the Hyrulean royal family's immediate guard detail. It boasts a high defense, but these days it's more a collector's item due to its ornamentation. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Highlands Depths.

Zonaite Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield used by Zonai and made of zonaite. It lowers the energy consumption of an attached Zonai device. It can be found in: Necluda Sky Archipelago, Eldin Sky Archipelago.

Strong Zonaite Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield used by Zonai and made of zonaite. It is moderately durable and lowers the energy consumption of an attached Zonai device. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, Lomei Labyrinth Island.

Dragonbone Boko Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Boko bow reinforced by fossils. Bokoblins handpicked the materials it's made from, so it boasts a respectable firepower. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Gerudo Highlands Depths.

Lizal Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A wooden bow created by Lizalfos. It's reinforced by the bones of a large fish— a marked improvement over any standard wooden bow. It can be found in: Lanayru Wetlands, Gerudo Desert Depths.

Emblazoned Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This shield features a traditional design from Necluda. Its combat capabilities aren't much better than the standard wooden shield, but it found popularity for its design. It can be found in: West Necluda, East Necluda.

Hunter'S Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Favored by hunters for its rabbit design, which is said to bring luck on hunts. It's easy to use, but its durability leaves something to be desired. It can be found in: Tabantha Frontier, Hebra Mountains.

Radiant Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This extravagant shield is presented to Gerudo warriors who rise to the rank of captain. Its apparent opulence is rivaled only by its combat capabilities. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Highlands.

Rusty Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. It's likely this rusty old shield once belonged to a knight. It still has some defensive capabilities, but its usefulness has been worn down by time. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Royal Guard'S Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This shield was forged using ancient Sheikah technology. It boasts extremely high stopping power, but its structural weakness made its low durability impractical for combat.

Boko Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Bokoblin-made shield created by attaching a handhold to any flat tree bark picked up off the ground. It's pretty shoddy, so don't expect it to last very long. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hebra Mountains.

Dragonbone Boko Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This Boko shield is reinforced with fossilized bone. Its defensive capabilities are respectable, but its predictably slipshod craftsmanship spells low durability. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Gerudo Desert.

Mighty Zonaite Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield used by Zonai and made of zonaite. It is very durable and draws on its stored energy to more efficiently use an attached Zonai device.

Savage Lynel Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This ultimate Lynel shield is favored by the White-Maned Lynels. It excels at defending against even the most brutal of attacks and cutting down powerful foes when deflecting. It can be found in: Akkala Highlands Depths, Central Hyrule Depths.

Strengthened Lizal Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Lizal bow with a grip reinforced by metal. The body is made from the branches of a flexible tree that grows near water, which offers some serious destructive power. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Akkala Highlands Depths.

Construct Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A bow used by a Captain Construct. Though simply built, it is made of fireproof materials and won't catch fire as wooden bows do. It can be found in: South Lanayru Sky Archipelago, North Gerudo Sky Archipelago.

Demon King'S Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A magical bow prized by the Demon King. Its performance reflects the power of its wielder. The higher your maximum number of hearts, the more its attack power increases.

Wooden Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This lightweight, simple shield is ideal for less experienced fighters. It can withstand light attacks, but blocking stronger blows is not recommended. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hebra Mountains.

Knight'S Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield favored by the knights who served the Hyrulean royal family. Its sturdy metal construction makes it quite durable, but its weight requires decent skill to wield. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Tabantha Frontier Depths.
Spiked Boko Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Boko shield made of slightly stronger wood and reinforced with animal bones. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Lynel Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A sturdy shield favored by Lynels for its defensive and offensive capabilities. First and foremost a shield, but the bladed edges can deal slashing attacks when deflecting. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Soldier'S Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield once used by the guards of Hyrule Castle. It's easy to handle, but its core is made of wood, so it can catch fire. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Kite Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Rito warriors cherish this shield. Its unique shape is designed with midbattle flight in mind to facilitate aerial combat. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier.

Lynel Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Lynel-made bow crafted from rough metal. True to the vicious nature of Lynel weaponry, it fires a spread of multiple arrows at once. Ideal for taking down quick-moving targets. It can be found in: East Necluda, Deep Akkala.

Savage Lynel Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This Lynel bow is made from a special steel found at the peak of Death Mountain. It has tremendous stopping power and can pierce thick armor as easily as thin paper. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Lanayru Wetlands Depths.

Mighty Lynel Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This massive Lynel bow sports a bowstring made from a metal so tough, mere Hylians have trouble drawing it back. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Akkala Highlands Depths.
Zonaite Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Zonai bow that draws power from your Energy Cell. Power drains, and arrows can fly much farther according to how long a shot is charged.

Gerudo Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The design of this metal shield has changed over time to match the Gerudo's sword-and- shield fighting style. It's favored by soldiers and travelers alike. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Highlands.

Daybreaker is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This shield was cherished by the Gerudo Champion Urbosa. The gold used to make it was handpicked to ensure a design that is both lightweight and very durable. It can be found in: Gerudo Town.

Traveler'S Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A sturdy shield loved by many an adventurer. It is made of animal hide and sturdy wood and is best suited to defending against weak monsters or animals. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Mountains.

Lizal Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A common shield found among the Lizalfos. It's made of metal, but its sloppy craftsmanship offers poor durability. It can be found in: Faron Sea, Lanayru Great Spring.

Reinforced Lizal Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This Lizal shield has been strengthened by adding a different type of metal to the mix. The edge is lined with spikes, so handle with care. It can be found in: Tabantha Tundra, Abandoned Kakariko Mine.

Fisherman'S Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. Often carried by fishermen for its fish design, which represents hope for a great catch. Its light wooden construction makes it convenient to take onto a boat. It can be found in: Lurelin Village.

Zora Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A Zora-made shield adorned with intricate ornamentation. It's said that true masters of this shield can redirect attacks as a rock redirects rushing water. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Lanayru Great Spring Sky.

Shield Of The Mind'S Eye is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A small Sheikah-made shield. Its design is intended to decrease blind spots without sacrificing too much defense. It can be found in: East Necluda, West Necluda.

Mighty Lynel Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This Lynel-made shield has been reinforced with armor and even more blades. Stronger in both defense and offense, it can tear through basic armor when deflecting. It can be found in: Faron Grasslands, Eldin Canyon Depths.

Steel Lizal Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This bow is wielded by Lizalfos who are expert marksmen. The metal that reinforces much of the weapon adds some additional weight but offers heightened durability. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands Depths, Central Hyrule Depths.

Duplex Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A bow favored by the skilled archers of the Yiga Clan. It's been engineered to fire two arrows at once to ensure your target comes to a swift and none-too-pleasant halt. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Desert Depths.

Strong Construct Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A sturdy bow for a Captain Construct. Besides being fireproof, it's been strengthened to allow for more powerful shots. It can be found in: Rising Island Chain, Death Mountain Depths.

Mighty Construct Bow is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A powerful bow for a Captain Construct. Though still fireproof, it's more complex than earlier models. The bowstring is extremely tense and requires great strength to draw. It can be found in: Lomei Labyrinth Island, Thyphlo Ruins.
Old Wooden Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. An aged, worn-out wooden shield. It can withstand lighter attacks, such as arrows. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Gerudo Desert.

Forest Dweller'S Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. The Koroks made this shield specifically for Hylians. It's made from the finest hard wood of trees that grow only in Korok Forest, so it's sturdier than it looks. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest.

Sea-Breeze Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. A shield said to have been the favorite of a hero who traveled the open seas. It was apparently a family heirloom, passed down through many generations.

Steel Lizal Shield is a Equipment in Tears of the Kingdom. This Lizal shield is adorned with several metal shells as a means of reinforcement. Its defensive capabilities are high, but its weight requires a skilled soldier to bear. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Mount Lanayru.

Spicy Pepper is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This pepper is exploding with spice. Cook with it to create dishes that will raise your body temperature and help you withstand the cold. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Desert.
Apple is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A common fruit eaten by people since ancient times. Eat it fresh, or cook it to increase its effect. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge.

Palm Fruit is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Fruit from palm trees that grow near the ocean. It doesn't offer any special effects but will increase your heart recovery when used as an ingredient. It can be found in: East Necluda, Gerudo Desert.

Fleet-Lotus Seeds is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. The plant that bears these seeds grows near deep water. The roots draw nutrients from the water, which boosts your movement speed when the seeds are cooked into a dish. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring.
Skyshroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A common mushroom that grows near trees on sky islands. Eat it to restore health. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Thunderhead Isles.

Hylian Tomato is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A fruit found widely from cold areas to warm climates. Full of nutrition, and kind of trendy lately. Use it in cooking to recover more hearts. It can be found in: East Necluda, West Necluda.

Splash Fruit is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A fruit that contains pressurized water. Cooking it brings out its ability to enhance swim speed when ingested. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, West Necluda.

Hyrule Herb is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This healthy herb has not changed since ancient times. Cook it before eating to increase the number of hearts it restores. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge.

Electric Safflina is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This medicinal plant grows abundantly in the Gerudo Desert. Its peculiar fibers conduct electricity, which will increase your electricity resistance when cooked into a dish. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Hyrule Ridge.

Blue Nightshade is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A plant that grows in quieter areas of Hyrule. At night, it gives off a soft glow. Cook with it to increase your stealth. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, West Necluda.

Fire Like Stone is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A stomach stone that persists even at high temperatures. It retains heat even outside the body of the creature that contained it, which makes it a useful elixir ingredient. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Eldin Mountains Depths.

Endura Shroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A rare yellowish-orange mushroom. Cook it before eating to temporarily increase your stamina limit. It can be found in: North Tabantha Sky Archipelago, North Necluda Sky Archipelago.

Big Hearty Truffle is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Years of going unpicked have allowed this hearty truffle to grow quite large. When cooked into a dish, it'll restore all hearts and temporarily increase your maximum hearts. It can be found in: East Necluda, Gerudo Desert.

Endura Carrot is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Highly valued as a medicinal plant, this carrot contains large amounts of nourishing energy. When cooked into a dish, it boosts your stamina beyond its maximum limit. It can be found in: East Necluda, Hyrule Ridge.

White Chuchu Jelly is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A jiggly substance that came from an Ice Chuchu. It's cool to the touch, and squeezing it seems to relieve stress. If struck, it will explode in a cold mist. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Gerudo Highlands.

Rushroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A mushroom that can grow almost anywhere but prefers ceilings and sheer cliffs. Cook it before eating to temporarily increase your movement speed. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Tabantha Frontier.

Big Hearty Radish is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This hearty radish is much larger than the average radish. When cooked into a dish, it restores all your hearts and temporarily increases your maximum hearts. It can be found in: Thunderhead Isles, North Necluda Sky Archipelago.

Warm Safflina is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This medicinal plant grows in hot regions, such as the Gerudo Desert. It's warm to the touch and increases your cold resistance when cooked into a dish. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Gerudo Desert.

Sundelion is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A wild plant that grows in the sun at high altitudes. Soaked in sunlight, its petals can restore health depleted by gloom when used in cooking. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Korok Frond is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A mysterious leaf that looks like it might be hiding something behind it. It has some medicinal value. Attach it to a stick and it can be used as a fan. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Lanayru Great Spring.

Keese Eyeball is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. These mysterious orbs scan their surroundings. Take advantage of their glaring awareness, and attach one to an arrow to grant a homing quality to the arrow. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda.

Like Like Stone is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A strange round stone from a Like Like, made of crystallized inner fluids. It's a good ingredient for elixirs. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Mountains.

Voltfruit is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Cacti found in the Gerudo Desert bear this sweet fruit. It's naturally insulated, so when cooked into a dish, it provides resistance against electricity. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.

Ice Fruit is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A fruit that generates cold when struck. Cooked correctly, it gives off an effect that strengthens muscles and increases attack power in cold temperatures. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains.

Shock Fruit is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. When cooked correctly, this shockingly tasty fruit stimulates the consumer's muscles and grants increased attack power during thunderstorms. It can be found in: East Necluda, Gerudo Desert.

Dazzlefruit is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A fruit charged with powerful light. Break it to unleash dazzling sparkles that blind any monsters nearby. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Gerudo Highlands.

Sunshroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A bright-red mushroom that grows in hot climates. Imbued with the power of heat, it can be used to cook dishes that will allow you to endure the bitter cold. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Gerudo Highlands.

Hearty Radish is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A rare radish that grows best in sunny plains. Cook it before eating to restore all your hearts and temporarily increase your maximum hearts. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, South Lanayru Sky Archipelago.

Swift Carrot is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This carrot is cultivated extensively in villages. It strengthens the legs and hips when cooked into a dish, which helps increase your movement speed. It can be found in: Kakariko Village, Hateno Village.

Fortified Pumpkin is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. An extremely tough pumpkin raised for food. When cooked, that toughness manifests itself by considerably upping defense. It can be found in: Kakariko Village, Hateno Village.

Armoranth is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This tough medicinal plant cannot be broken, but it can be cooked. Its durable yet flexible fibers raise your defense when cooked into a dish. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Akkala Highlands.

Bomb Flower is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A dangerous flower that contains explosive elements. Does not mix well with fire or electricity, unless the goal is to blow things up. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves, The Depths.

Golden Apple is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A rare, very sweet fruit that seems to have an extra sparkle to it. Sometimes found near normal apples. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge.

Hydromelon is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This resilient fruit can flourish even in the heat of the desert. The hydrating liquid inside provides a cooling effect that, when cooked, increases your heat resistance. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.

Stamella Shroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A nutritious mushroom chock-full of natural energy. Cook it to release its stamina-restoration properties. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, West Necluda.

Ironshroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. The cap of this mushroom is very hard. Use it when cooking to prepare a dish that increases your defense. It can be found in: East Necluda, West Necluda.

Silent Princess is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This lovely flower was said to have been a favorite of the princess of Hyrule. They were once feared to have gone extinct, but it's not uncommon to spot them growing in the wild. It can be found in: Akkala Highlands, Hyrule Ridge.

Courser Bee Honey is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Honey straight from the hive is chock-full of nutrients. Cooking this into a meal unlocks the potential of these nutrients and provides a stamina-recovery effect. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Hylian Pine Cone is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Grows on trees found all over Hyrule. It contains oil and burns well. Throw it into a fire to increase the intensity of the flame. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Lanayru Great Spring.

Yellow Chuchu Jelly is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A jiggly substance that came from an Electric Chuchu. Electricity pulses through its gelatinous mass. If struck, it will explode in a burst of electric current. It can be found in: West Necluda, Gerudo Desert.
Hylian Shroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A common mushroom found near trees around Hyrule. Eat it to restore half a heart. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge.

Hearty Truffle is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This rare mushroom has a rich scent. It'll restore all your hearts and temporarily increase your maximum hearts when used in cooking. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda.

Zapshroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This mushroom grows wild in the Gerudo region. The cap is naturally insulated, so when used in cooking, it will offer protection against electricity. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Lanayru Wetlands.

Razorshroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This mushroom is known for the natural slice in its cap. Eating it fosters your competitive spirit. Use it when cooking to prepare a dish that will increase your strength. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, Tabantha Frontier.

Brightcap is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A mushroom that grows in caves and contains luminescent enzymes. Cook it into a dish to give a glowing effect to anyone who eats it. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves.
Puffshroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A mushroom that spreads a cloud of fine spores when a stimulus is applied. The bitter powder makes them inedible. It can be found in: The Depths.

Cool Safflina is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This medicinal plant grows in high elevations, such as mountains in the Hebra or Gerudo regions. When cooked into a dish, it will temporarily increase your heat resistance. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier.

Mighty Thistle is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This medicinal plant is known for its sharp thorns and for the fruit it bears. The fruit contains a compound that increases attack power when cooked into a dish. It can be found in: East Necluda, Faron Grasslands.

Giant Brightbloom Seed is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A seed that's found underground. When struck, it will take root and bloom, radiating a large amount of light from a big flower. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves.

Red Chuchu Jelly is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A jiggly substance that normally comes from a Fire Chuchu. It consistently gives off heat. If struck, it will explode in a ball of flame. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Eldin Mountains.

Fire Keese Eyeball is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Fire Keese eyeballs are imbued with heat and are useful in making elixirs. Attach one to an arrow to grant a homing quality to the arrow. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Eldin Mountains Depths.

Silent Shroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A strange mushroom that glows softly in the forest at night. Cooking it into a dish unlocks the nutrients in its cap, resulting in a meal that will allow you to move stealthily. It can be found in: Akkala Highlands, West Necluda.

Chuchu Jelly is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A gelatinous substance that came from a Chuchu. It's unusable in this state, but applying a bit of elemental stimulation will change its form. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Electric Keese Eyeball is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Electric Keese eyeballs are imbued with electric power and are useful in making elixirs. Attach one to an arrow to grant a homing quality to the arrow. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Desert Depths.

Wildberry is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A fruit that grows in cold, snowy regions known for its tangy, sweet flavor. It doesn't offer any special effects, but it's a popular cooking ingredient. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains.

Mighty Bananas is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This fruit grows mainly in tropical forests of the Faron region. When it's used as an ingredient, the resulting dish will temporarily increase your attack power. It can be found in: Lake Floria, Eventide Island.

Fire Fruit is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A fruit that generates heat when struck. Cooked correctly, its heating properties improve blood flow and stimulate muscles to raise attack power in high temperatures. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Chillshroom is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Often found at the base of pine trees in cold climates, these mushrooms are cool to the touch and can be used to cook dishes that allow you to stay cool even in arid regions. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains.

Stambulb is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A wild plant with bulging roots often found in cooler climates. It contains nutrients that increase endurance. Cook it to restore stamina. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Thunderhead Isles.

Sun Pumpkin is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A new variety of pumpkin that soaks up the sunshine in Hateno Village. Baked into a dish, it can help heal the effects of exposure to gloom. It can be found in: Hateno Village.

Swift Violet is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This vitality-rich flower blooms mainly on cliffsides. When cooked into a dish, the nourishing compounds increase your movement speed. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Tabantha Frontier.

Brightbloom Seed is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A seed that's often found in caves or wells. When struck, it will take root and bloom, giving off faint light from a small flower. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves.
Muddle Bud is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A wildflower with a powerful odor that can disorient and confuse, making it difficult to tell friend from foe. It can be found in: The Depths.

Ice Keese Eyeball is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Ice Keese eyeballs are imbued with freezing power and are useful in making elixirs. Attach one to an arrow to grant a homing quality to the arrow. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Mount Lanayru.
Silver Moblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A nasty-looking, rock-hard horn. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir.

Silver Lizalfos Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sickle-shaped horn that looks like it could slice anything it touches. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir.

Black Horriblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This large, heavy horn has slowly grown into its present hammer-like shape. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves, Gerudo Desert Depths.

Blue-Maned Lynel Saber Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. The sharp, blade-like horn of a Blue-Maned Lynel. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase its attack power. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Eldin Canyon Depths.

White-Maned Lynel Mace Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. The claw-like ends of this White-Maned Lynel horn are all extremely hard. Attach to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Faron Grasslands Depths, Central Hyrule Depths.

Molduga Jaw is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A hard jawbone. Its shape allows a Molduga some maneuverability in the sand. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert.

Black Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A vicious, three-pronged horn. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Hyrule Ridge Depths.

Blue Lizalfos Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A very long, sword-like horn. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to brew an elixir. It can be found in: Mount Lanayru, Akkala Highlands Depths.

Blue Horriblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A hammer-shaped horn with spiky bumps. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Death Mountain, Death Mountain Depths.

Silver Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A large, blade-like horn with a unique flourish on the tip. It's sharper than it looks. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir.

Blue Boss Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. An axe-shaped horn with a band to identify it as belonging to a leader. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Lanayru Great Spring.

Blue Moblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A large, curved horn with two extremely hard tips. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Lynel Saber Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This blade-like Lynel horn is extremely sharp. It increases a weapon's attack power when attached. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Captain Construct Ii Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sharp, blade-like horn with a split tip that easily slices anything it touches. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase attack power. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, West Necluda.

Ice-Breath Lizalfos Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. The freezing power embedded in this horn's crystal tip can be used to your advantage if you know how. Otherwise, cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Gerudo Highlands.

Horriblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. An elongated hammer-shaped horn with a hard, flat front. Attach to a weapon to increase attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves, Eldin Canyon Depths.

White-Maned Lynel Saber Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This blade-like horn of a White-Maned Lynel can slash through just about anything. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase attack power. Cook with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Faron Grasslands Depths, Central Hyrule Depths.

Silver Lynel Saber Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This piercing horn is sharpened to a point for maximum poking. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir.

Captain Construct Iii Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sharp, blade-like horn with a complex tip. It looks almost decorative. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase attack power. It can be found in: Thyphlo Ruins, Lanayru Sky Archipelago.

Captain Construct Iv Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A mean-looking, branching, blade-like horn. Its edges and tips are extremely sharp. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power.

Gleeok Thunder Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A crown-like, lightning-imbued horn of a Gleeok. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Faron Grasslands.

Obsidian Frox Fang is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A giant fang for excavating and crushing ores. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert Depths, Hyrule Ridge Depths.

Lynel Mace Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A hard, curved Lynel horn. It isn't fully grown, but it can be attached to a weapon to increase its attack power, or cooked with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Blue-Maned Lynel Mace Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. Its ends are split apart, but this horn from a Blue-Maned Lynel is solid. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase its attack power, or brew it into an elixir. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Eldin Canyon Depths.

Soldier Construct Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A blade-like horn from a Soldier Construct. It's very sharp, so handle with care. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, North Gerudo Sky Archipelago.

Soldier Construct Ii Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sharp, hooked horn dropped from a Soldier Construct II. It's well suited for slicing through small branches and plants. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase attack power. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Rising Island Chain.

Soldier Construct Iv Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A horn embedded with a sharp disk. The disk spins mysteriously and can slice through almost anything. Attach the horn to a weapon and vastly increase its attack power.

Captain Construct I Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This wavy, double-edged, blade-like horn is formidable when it comes to slashing. Attach it to a weapon to increase attack power. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Rising Island Chain.

Black Hinox Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A horn wrapped in dangerous debris. It's easy to work with and greatly increases the attack power of a weapon when attached. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: East Necluda, West Necluda Depths.

Frox Fang is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A giant, ore-crunching Frox fang. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands Depths, Central Hyrule Depths.

Blue-White Frox Fang is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A giant fang that can easily dig through solid bedrock. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains Depths, Tabantha Frontier Depths.
Light Dragon'S Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A horn chipped off the Light Dragon. Its gentle glow has a calming effect, and it has a mysterious healing power when attached to a weapon.

Gibdo Bone is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A creepy bone with multiple sharp tips. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power. It tends to break easily due to its odd shape. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Desert Depths.

Ice Like Stone is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A stomach stone kept cold inside a very low-temperature body. It stays cold, even outside the body of the creature that contained it. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Mount Lanayru, Gerudo Highlands.

Boss Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. The band on this sword-shaped horn shows that it belonged to a leader. Attach it to a weapon to increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge.

Silver Boss Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A circular, serrated horn. The neatly tied strap contains arcane power. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir.

Black Moblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A hefty horn with multiple tough barbs. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Deep Akkala.

Electric Lizalfos Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A horn charged with as much electricity as a bolt of lightning. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It will discharge electricity when stimulated. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Faron.

Silver Horriblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A curved horn with an extremely hard tip. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir.

Silver Lynel Mace Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This wickedly barbed Silver Lynel horn is as hard as a diamond. Attach to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power. It's also a precious elixir ingredient.

Blue Hinox Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This mean-looking horn is wrapped in hard chains. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: East Necluda Depths, West Necluda.

Stalnox Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. The impaled skulls should serve as a warning. But if you do obtain one, attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: East Necluda, Central Hyrule Depths.

Gleeok Flame Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A crown-like, fire-imbued horn of a Gleeok. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Lake Hylia.

Dinraal'S Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sharp horn of the red spirit, Dinraal. It is said to be the crystallized power of fire itself. Attach the blade-shaped horn to a weapon to vastly increase attack power.

Lizalfos Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A thin, sharp, knife-like horn. Attach it to a weapon to increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to brew an elixir. It can be found in: Lanayru Wetlands, Lanayru Great Spring.

Shock Like Stone is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A stomach stone exposed to high voltage inside the body of a Shock Like. It maintains some charge even outside the creature. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Black Boss Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A double-edged, axe-shaped horn with two leader bands. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda.

Moblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A hard horn that resulted from a skull mutation. Attach it to a weapon to increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Black Lizalfos Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A blade-like, serrated horn. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to brew an elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, East Necluda.

Soldier Construct Iii Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A serrated horn from a Soldier Construct III. Attach it to a weapon to greatly increase attack power. It can cut through plants and large trees. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, Thunderhead Isles.

Shard Of Dinraal'S Spike is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. An incredibly hard stone mined from a spike on Dinraal's back. It is very destructive when fused to a weapon, and it also imbues that weapon with the power of flame.

Fire-Breath Lizalfos Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A horn that glows red with the power of fire. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. The right combination could draw out the blazing power contained within. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Gerudo Highlands.

Hinox Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A horn wrapped in spiked wood. Attach it to a weapon to increase attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, West Necluda.

Gleeok Frost Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A crown-like, frost-imbued horn of a Gleeok. Attach it to a weapon to vastly increase its attack power. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains.

Shard Of Naydra'S Spike is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. An incredibly hard stone mined from a spike on Naydra's back. It is very destructive when fused to a weapon, and it also imbues that weapon with the power of ice.

Aerocuda Eyeball is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. This eyeball is constantly trying to focus on its targets. Cook it with a critter to make an elixir, or attach it to an arrow to grant a homing quality to the arrow. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule.

Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sharp horn with multiple barbs. Attach it to a weapon to increase its attack power, or cook it with a critter to make an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths.

Blue Bokoblin Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A two-pronged horn with sharp edges and tips. Attach it to a weapon to moderately increase its attack power, or brew it into an elixir. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon.

Naydra'S Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sharp horn of the blue spirit, Naydra. It is said to be the crystallized power of ice itself. Attach the blade-shaped horn to a weapon to vastly increase attack power.

Farosh'S Horn is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. A sharp horn of the golden spirit, Farosh. It is said to be the crystallized power of electricity itself. Attach the blade-shaped horn to a weapon to vastly increase attack power.

Shard Of Farosh'S Spike is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. An incredibly hard stone mined from a spike on Farosh's back. It is very destructive when fused to a weapon, and it also imbues that weapon with the power to shock.

Shard Of Light Dragon'S Spike is a Material in Tears of the Kingdom. An incredibly hard stone mined from a spike on the Light Dragon's back. It is very destructive when fused to a weapon, and it also imbues that weapon with healing power.

Water Octorok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. Although they spend most of their time in water, they burst out when they sense someone. The rocks they spit out can be bounced back with a shield. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, West Necluda. It drops: octorok tentacle, octo balloon, octorok eyeball.

Fire Chuchu is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This low-level gel monster is engulfed in flames. Its strength varies depending on its size. It tends to explode if attacked from close range, so the use of spears, arrows, and other ranged weapons is advised. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Eldin Mountains. It drops: red chuchu jelly.

Keese is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The unpredictable flight pattern of this nocturnal, bat-like species can make fighting them a nuisance, but they're weak enough to fell with a single strike. Sometimes they like to form packs, and they have been seen swarming out of caves together. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, West Necluda. It drops: keese wing, keese eyeball.

Electric Keese is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The electricity that engulfs the bodies of these bat-like Keese makes them more dangerous than the standard type. They're capable of shocking anything they touch. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Desert Depths. It drops: electric keese wing, electric keese eyeball.

Ice Chuchu is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This low-level gel monster is engulfed in freezing-cold air. Its strength varies depending on its size. It tends to explode if attacked from close range, so the use of spears, arrows, and other ranged weapons is advised. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains. It drops: white chuchu jelly.

Chuchu is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This low-level, gel-based monster can be found all over Hyrule. It tends to spring its attacks on unsuspecting prey from the ground or from trees. Its strength varies by size, and the type of jelly it drops varies depending on whether the Chuchu was heated up, cooled down, or shocked. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda. It drops: chuchu jelly.

Rock Octorok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This octopus-like species of monster lives in volcanic regions. When they inhale, they're preparing to spit out flaming rocks. Be aware of that powerful suction. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Death Mountain. It drops: octorok tentacle, octo balloon, octorok eyeball.

Moblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This heavyweight species of monster can be found all over Hyrule. They're physically very strong, with a horn hard enough to crush a rock. With their incredibly powerful arms, Moblins have been known to pick up Bokoblins and throw them as makeshift projectile weapons. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths. It drops: moblin horn, moblin fang.

Blue Horriblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. After the Upheaval, these monsters began appearing in Hyrule's cave systems. Compared to the red variety, they have more stamina and more developed limbs, enabling them to hurl large rocks with ease. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves, Death Mountain Depths. It drops: blue horriblin horn, horriblin guts, horriblin claw.

Black Horriblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. After the Upheaval, these monsters began appearing in Hyrule's cave systems. Because of the inordinate amount of time they spend moving along cave walls and ceilings, they have developed great strength in their mighty arms. This variety poses a huge threat to even the most experienced adventurers. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves, Gerudo Desert Depths. It drops: black horriblin horn, horriblin claw, horriblin horn.

Shock Like is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These monsters can be found all over Hyrule in dark places such as caves. They generate electricity inside their bodies and expel powerful lightning balls from their mouths. It's believed that they stun their prey this way, but there are still many unknowns about them. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda. It drops: shock like stoneshock fruitarrow x5.

Evermean is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A monster that mimics a tree, found throughout the forests of Hyrule. These impostors are hard to differentiate from the genuine article, making it easy for them to team up and pounce on unsuspecting passersby. Because the species shares characteristics with trees, it can be chopped down in much the same way. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, Hyrule Field. It drops: energetic rhino beetlebladed rhino beetlerugged rhino beetleacornhightail lizardsturdy thick stickchickaloo tree nutmonster extractkorok frondgolden apple.

Boss Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These heavyweight monsters are leaders of Bokoblins. They swagger about, whistling commands to the teams of minions nervously trailing them. Their heavy horns are so sharp, they can slice large trees clean in half. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Hyrule Ridge. It drops: boss bokoblin horn, boss bokoblin fang.

Black Boss Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These heavyweight monsters are leaders of Bokoblins, and this variety has very high stamina thanks to their large muscles. Even skilled warriors will find them challenging due to their coordinated attacks involving minions. And those horns are just pure evil. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda. It drops: black boss bokoblin horn, boss bokoblin fang, boss bokoblin guts.

Blue Moblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These heavyweight monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They're much tougher than their standard counterparts, with more powerful arms and a fully developed horn on their heads to smash things with. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon. It drops: blue moblin horn, moblin fang, moblin guts.

Stalmoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The remains of Moblins appear in the dark. Even the toughest Moblins become fragile when they're little more than a pile of bones, so they'll crumble after just a few attacks. However, as long as a skull remains intact, they'll continue to pull themselves back together and go on fighting. They have hard, heavy horns, and they hate strong light. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, Deep Akkala Depths. It drops: moblin horn, moblin fang.

Electric Lizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These quick-witted, lizard-like monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They can emit strong electrical currents from their bodies, so don't get too close. Their horns are brimming with electricity, which will discharge and arc to nearby areas if struck by an arrow. They live in desert climates. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Faron. It drops: electric lizalfos horn, lizalfos talon, electric lizalfos tail.

Horriblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. After the Upheaval, these monsters began appearing in Hyrule's cave systems. They have sturdy horns that are perfect for crushing rocks and strong muscles that allow them to traverse cave walls and ceilings as easily as if they were walking on the ground. They often hang from ceilings, waiting for prey. It can be found in: Hyrule Caves, Eldin Canyon Depths. It drops: horriblin horn, horriblin claw.

Gibdo is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A monster that appeared along with the sand shroud. Though slow to move, they can fight without faltering to physical attacks thanks to their tough outer skin. On the other hand, they are vulnerable to fire and lightning, which can turn them white and brittle. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Desert Depths. It drops: gibdo guts, gibdo bone.

Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This common species is a nuisance all over Hyrule. While not very clever, they are at least intelligent enough to hunt beasts and grill the meat for food. They are sometimes seen marching in groups. If they come at you, watch out for their sharp horns! It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths. It drops: bokoblin horn, bokoblin fang.

Stalizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The remains of Lizalfos appear in the dark. They're as sly as ever—even now that they're just some bones stacked atop each other—and still possess blade-like sharp horns. If a skull remains intact, they will pull themselves back up and continue to fight. It can be found in: Lanayru Wetlands, Lanayru Great Spring. It drops: lizalfos horn, lizalfos talon.

Ice-Breath Lizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A quick-witted, lizard-like species of monster found all over Hyrule. They are a troublesome species that spit balls of ice and store freezing power inside their pale horns, but will die instantly if touched by fire. They live mainly on snowy mountains. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Gerudo Highlands. It drops: lizalfos talon, ice-breath lizalfos tail, ice-breath lizalfos horn.

White-Maned Lynel is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These hooved monsters are said to have lived all over Hyrule since ancient times and are known to be especially dangerous. They are extremely intelligent and resilient and bear very powerful horns. There is very little eyewitness information, because few who encounter them return alive. It can be found in: Faron Grasslands Depths, Central Hyrule Depths. It drops: white-maned lynel mace horn, white-maned lynel saber horn, lynel hoof, lynel guts, arrow x10.

Silver Lynel is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. Silver Lynels are not to be trifled with. The Demon King's fiendish magic has made them the strongest of the Lynel species, beyond even the deadly white-maned variety. Their powerful horns can slice through almost anything. Think of their purple stripes as a warning to keep away. It drops: silver lynel saber horn, silver lynel mace horn, lynel hoof, lynel guts, arrow x10.

Captain Construct I is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An elite Soldier Construct, hence its "captain" title. Made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. As a standard-rank member of the captain class, its combat functions are more sophisticated than those of Soldier Constructs. It can use Fuse to enhance its weapons. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, Rising Island Chain. It drops: captain construct i horn, zonai charge.

Electric Chuchu is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This low-level gel monster is engulfed in electricity. Its strength varies depending on its size. It tends to explode if attacked from close range, so the use of spears, arrows, and other ranged weapons is advised. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, West Necluda. It drops: yellow chuchu jelly.

Treasure Octorok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These particularly clever monsters bury themselves in deep sand or snow and disguise themselves as treasure chests. Anyone who approaches the chests is attacked. It is said that the treasure chests on their heads are actually parts of these monsters' bodies. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Faron Grasslands. It drops: octorok tentacle, octo balloon, octorok eyeball, green rupee, blue rupee, red rupee, purple rupee, silver rupee.

Ice Wizzrobe is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They create freezing blasts of air, summon frozen monsters, and have been known to cause blizzards to severely decrease the temperature around them. The weather will normalize once the Wizzrobe is defeated. It can be found in: Tabantha Tundra, Hebra Mountains. It drops: none.

Blizzrobe is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They use staves to create freezing blasts of air or to summon frozen monsters and have been known to cause blizzards to severely decrease the temperature around them. They are more dangerous than Ice Wizzrobes. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands. It drops: none.
