Fire Like is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These monsters live mostly in caves near volcanoes. They belch scorching fire out of their maws. There are still many mysteries about them, but it seems they don't do well in the cold. Don't get too close, or they'll gulp you up into their large gullets and give you an all- too-close look at their insides. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Eldin Mountains Depths. It drops: fire like stonefire fruitarrow x5.

Blue Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This common species is a nuisance all over Hyrule. They're tougher than the red Bokoblins—and their horns are sharper, so watch out! It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon. It drops: blue bokoblin horn, bokoblin fang, bokoblin guts.

Silver Boss Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The mightiest of all Boss Bokoblins. It's a wonder that they're related at all to the lowly, garden-variety Bokoblin. The evil power of the Demon King dwells in their bodies and horns, enabling formidable attacks. And watch out for the elite minions that hang around them too. It drops: silver boss bokoblin horn, boss bokoblin guts, boss bokoblin fang.

Black Lizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A quick-witted, lizard-like species of monster found all over Hyrule. Their sharpened horn cuts like a knife, so be cautious even if they're not carrying a weapon. They are among the most dangerous Lizalfos, with high stamina. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, East Necluda. It drops: lizalfos talon, black lizalfos tail, black lizalfos horn.

Silver Horriblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The mightiest of the cave masters. The purple markings on their bodies are due to the overwhelming magic power of the Demon King. Their tough bodies and horns have been strengthened beyond the levels seen in their lesser relatives, making these monsters more dangerous than others of their ilk. It drops: horriblin claw, horriblin guts, silver horriblin horn.

Blue-Maned Lynel is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These fearsome monsters have lived in Hyrule since ancient times. Compared to the standard Lynel, those with blue manes are much tougher, with much sharper horns. Facing off against a Lynel is ill-advised, but if you must, be sure you're very well prepared. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Eldin Canyon Depths. It drops: blue-maned lynel saber horn, blue-maned lynel mace horn, lynel guts, lynel hoof, arrow x10.

Captain Construct Ii is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An elite Soldier Construct, hence its "captain" title. Made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. Compared to standard Captain Constructs, it has some upgrades, including enhanced endurance and more powerful weapons. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, West Necluda. It drops: captain construct ii horn, zonai charge.

Thunder Wizzrobe is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They hurl multiple balls of electricity, summon monsters surging with electricity, and have been known to cause thunderstorms in the area. They are more resilient and dangerous than Electric Wizzrobes. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, East Necluda. It drops: none.

Snow Octorok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These octopus-like monsters live in snowy fields and disguise themselves as grass. When someone wanders by, they spring into action and attack by spitting snowballs. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains. It drops: octorok tentacle, octo balloon, octorok eyeball.

Rock Like is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These monsters can be found all over Hyrule in dark places such as caves. They're covered in rocks that shield them like armor. They try to intimidate you by spitting rocks out of their mouths, but they can be quieted when they have swallowed something. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Lanayru Wetlands. It drops: like like stonearrow x5.

Aerocuda is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An airborne monster that can be recognized by its distinctive cries. They have strong, dexterous feet and can often be seen cruising through the sky with animals or other monsters in their clutches. Thankfully, the breed's lightweight, aerodynamic body makes it easy to shoot down. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule. It drops: aerocuda wing, aerocuda eyeball.

Black Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. Although Bokoblins are generally a nuisance, the Black Bokoblins are among the most dangerous type. They're extremely resilient and powerful, especially when it comes to their forceful attacks with their hefty horns. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Hyrule Ridge Depths. It drops: black bokoblin horn, bokoblin fang, bokoblin guts.

Silver Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. You would be foolish to call these Silver Bokoblins a mere nuisance. They have been influenced by Ganon's fiendish magic, so they are stronger than even the Black Bokoblins. It's said that the Demon King's power marked their silver bodies with purple patterns. The magical glow at the tip of their horns may look funny at a glance, but don't take these creatures lightly, or the joke will be on you. It drops: silver bokoblin horn, bokoblin fang, bokoblin guts.

Blue Boss Bokoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These heavyweight monsters are leaders of Bokoblins. They've got more stamina than the red variety, and they execute powerful punches and weapon attacks. The horns on their heads are sharper too. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Lanayru Great Spring. It drops: blue boss bokoblin horn, boss bokoblin guts, boss bokoblin fang.

Silver Lizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These Lizalfos have been influenced by the Demon King's fiendish magic to become the mightiest of all Lizalfos. They're called "silver" for their unique coloring and also to denote their rarity. Their horns, turned ominous by the Demon King's influence, can cut anything with the slightest touch. It drops: silver lizalfos tail, silver lizalfos horn, lizalfos talon.

Soldier Construct I is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A standard-issue combat construct made by the Zonai with ancient techniques and magic. It faithfully obeys commands and tries to root out any being it deems to be an enemy. The decoration on its head is sharp and cuts like a blade. It can be found in: Great Sky Island, North Gerudo Sky Archipelago. It drops: zonai charge, soldier construct i horn.

Soldier Construct Iv is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A sophisticated variant of the combat construct made by the Zonai with ancient techniques and magic. Unlike lower-ranked Soldier Constructs, its body sports a striking golden color. Comes equipped with excellent attack power and endurance, not to mention a majestic decoration on its head. It drops: soldier construct iv horn, zonai charge.

Fire Keese is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The fire that engulfs the bodies of these bat- like Keese makes them more dangerous than the standard type. They're capable of setting fire to anything they touch. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Eldin Mountains Depths. It drops: fire keese wing, fire keese eyeball.

Ice Keese is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The intense frost that engulfs the bodies of these bat-like Keese makes them more dangerous than the standard type. They're capable of freezing anything they touch. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains, Mount Lanayru. It drops: ice keese wing, ice keese eyeball.

Forest Octorok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. Although originally an aquatic species, this type has adapted to life in the forest. They hide among the trees, disguising themselves as grass or unassuming shrubbery, and then attack when someone wanders by. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Deep Akkala. It drops: octorok tentacle, octo balloon, octorok eyeball.

Fire Wizzrobe is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They hurl fireballs, summon flaming monsters, and have been known to severely raise the temperature around them. The weather will normalize once the Wizzrobe is defeated. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Eldin Canyon. It drops: none.

Electric Wizzrobe is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They hurl balls of electricity, summon monsters surging with electricity, and have been known to cause thunderstorms in the area. The weather will normalize once the Wizzrobe is defeated. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring, Tabantha Frontier. It drops: none.

Stalkoblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These remains of Bokoblins hate light and only move about in the dark. While they're fragile enough to crumble from a single blow, they have sharp horns. And as long as a skull remains intact, they'll continue to pull themselves back together and go on fighting. It can be found in: Great Hyrule Forest, Gerudo Desert Depths. It drops: bokoblin horn, bokoblin fang.

Meteo Wizzrobe is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These spell-casting monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They hurl multiple fireballs, summon flaming monsters, and have been known to severely raise the temperature around them. They are more resilient than Fire Wizzrobes. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Akkala Highlands. It drops: none.

Like Like is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A monster that has been appearing all over Hyrule in recent days. Found dwelling in caves and other dark places. It has an appetite for swords and shields. If you get too close, it may lunge at you with its mouth wide, swallow you whole, and eat your equipment. The tongue in the center of its mouth is very sensitive. Attack it to make the creature falter. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, East Necluda. It drops: like like stonearrow x5.

Ice Like is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These monsters live mostly in caves in snowy areas. They belch freezing cold air out of their maws. There are still many mysteries about them, but it seems they don't do well with fire. Don't get too close, or they'll gulp you up into their large gullets and give you an all- too-close look at their insides. It can be found in: Mount Lanayru, Gerudo Highlands. It drops: ice like stoneice fruitarrow x5.

Moth Gibdo is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These monsters appeared along with the sand shroud. Winged horrors that attack quickly while in flight, they have tough skin that allows them to withstand physical attacks. Fire and lightning are effective against them. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert, Gerudo Desert Depths. It drops: gibdo wing, gibdo guts, gibdo bone.

Black Moblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These heavyweight monsters can be found all over Hyrule and are among the most dangerous types of Moblin. They're extremely resilient, and a blow from the heavy horn can easily crush a rock. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Deep Akkala. It drops: black moblin horn, moblin fang, moblin guts.

Silver Moblin is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The Demon King's fiendish magic has imbued Silver Moblins with the greatest power and resilience of all the Moblins. They're called "silver" for their body color as well as their rarity. The purple patterns on their bodies also help them to stand out. The ominous-looking horn has the potential for a powerful attack. It drops: silver moblin horn, moblin fang, moblin guts.

Lizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These quick-witted, lizard-like monsters can be found all over Hyrule. They're a sly species that lurk underwater or use camouflage to blend in with the environment to launch ambushes. Moreover, they never sleep. And even when they have no weapons, they'll come at you swinging their sword-like horn. It can be found in: Lanayru Wetlands, Lanayru Great Spring. It drops: lizalfos horn, lizalfos tail, lizalfos talon.

Blue Lizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These quick-witted, lizard-like monsters can be found all over Hyrule. Compared to the green Lizalfos, many of these carry much stronger weapons and are extremely dangerous with their longer and sharper horn. It can be found in: Mount Lanayru, Akkala Highlands. It drops: blue lizalfos horn, blue lizalfos tail, lizalfos talon.

Fire-Breath Lizalfos is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These quick-witted, lizard-like monsters can be found all over Hyrule. Their fiery breath makes them pretty dangerous, but exposure to cold will kill them instantly. The lava-like horn retains extreme heat and burns anything that touches it. They mainly live in volcanic regions. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Gerudo Highlands. It drops: fire-breath lizalfos tail, fire-breath lizalfos horn, lizalfos talon.

Lynel is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These fearsome monsters have lived in Hyrule since ancient times. They possess intense intelligence and resilience, as well as a piercing horn, making them among the most dangerous monsters in all the land. This is compounded by their natural resistance to all elements. Only challenge a Lynel if you're very well prepared. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Central Hyrule Depths. It drops: lynel saber horn, lynel mace horn, lynel hoof, arrow x10.

Soldier Construct Ii is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A mid-tier combat construct made by the Zonai with ancient techniques and magic. It faithfully obeys commands and tries to root out any being it deems to be an enemy. The heavy decoration on its head can be swung like an axe in slash attacks. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains. It drops: soldier construct ii horn, zonai charge.

Soldier Construct Iii is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An upper-tier combat construct made by the Zonai with ancient techniques and magic. It faithfully obeys commands and tries to root out any being it deems to be an enemy. The decoration on its head, designed to intimidate foes, becomes a powerful weapon when swung around. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, Thunderhead Isles. It drops: zonai charge, soldier construct iii horn.

Stalnox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The remains of a Hinox, a giant monster with only one eye. This skeletal beast appears in the dark and can throw its own rib bones at enemies. Furthermore, even if it appears defeated, it will keep coming back for more as long as its eye is left intact. It can be found in: East Necluda, West Necluda Depths. It drops: stalnox horn, hinox tooth.

Moragia is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An enormous monster dwelling in Death Mountain. Its body is composed of boiling lava and hard rocks that are infused with gloom. To keep its body held together, the creature draws heat and gloom power from the crater. It can be found in: Death Mountain.

Demon Dragon is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The form that Ganondorf, the Demon King, attained after swallowing a secret stone and attaining his true power. No trace of his original form remains. Its overwhelming magical strength would shake the skies. The jet-black scales covering it repel any and all attacks, save for those of the one and only Master Sword.

Battle Talus is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. Monsters have built structures onto this Talus to create what might be called a moving fort. Its body is reinforced with wooden planks to keep away enemies. It can't be easily climbed. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Tabantha Frontier Depths. It drops: ruby, opal, amber, flint.

Flux Construct Ii is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A construct composed of interconnected blocks, made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. This model has been upgraded to process complex commands and assume modified shapes. To provide sufficient energy to power its gigantic form, this construct contains a massive store of Zonai charge. It can be found in: Lanayru Sky Archipelago, Mount Lanayru Depths. It drops: zonai charge, large zonai charge.

Master Kohga is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The leader of the Yiga Clan, who worship the Demon King. His larger-than-life presence makes him popular and deeply respected. After the Upheaval, Kohga latched on to Zonai devices as a way to increase his power. He had his underlings use the technology to make a variety of bizarre and deadly contraptions to kill you with.

Training Construct is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The Zonai employed advanced technology and magic to create this instructional construct. Its color indicates that it is equipped with special combat-training functions. It is even capable of using Fuse to modify and strengthen its weapons. It drops: zonai charge.

Black Hinox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These giant, one-eyed monsters live mostly in the woods and have extremely hard horns. A keen awareness of your surroundings is paramount when facing one, as Hinox are known for tearing entire trees from the ground and using them as weapons. Black Hinox wear metal greaves that are too hard to break. A deft hand can steal weapons off the necklaces they wear. It can be found in: East Necluda, West Necluda Depths. It drops: hinox toenail, hinox tooth, black hinox horn, hinox guts, seared steak, roasted bird drumstick, seared prime steak, roasted bird thigh, seared gourmet steak, roasted whole bird.

Demon King Ganondorf (2Nd Form) is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The fearsome form that Demon King Ganondorf attained after unleashing the power of the secret stone. The ancient sages were no match for him and only barely managed to contain his devastating power. The gloom he produces is a corrosive substance so foul that it can wither anyone who touches it.

Flame Gleeok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This three-headed monster first appeared after the Upheaval. Fighting it alone is inadvisable, as its three heads will attack you all at once. Creates powerful flames within its body. When someone sets foot upon its turf, this beast will engulf the intruder and their surroundings in a fierce blaze. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, Eldin Canyon. It drops: gleeok flame horn, gleeok wing, gleeok guts.

Dinraal is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A spirit of fire has taken the form of this giant dragon. Making its home in the Eldin region, it's said to have served the Spring of Power since ancient times. The flames that coat its body can make the surrounding area blazing hot, but Dinraal bears no ill will toward people. Few have seen it in the current age. It can be found in: Eldin Mountains, Deep Akkala. It drops: dinraal's claw, dinraal's scale, shard of dinraal's spike, shard of dinraal's fang, dinraal's horn.

Naydra is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A spirit of ice has taken the form of this giant dragon. Making its home in the Lanayru region, it's said to have served the Spring of Wisdom since ancient times. The ice that coats its body can make the surrounding area freezing cold, but Naydra bears no ill will toward people. Few have seen it in the current age. It can be found in: East Necluda, Mount Lanayru. It drops: naydra's scale, shard of naydra's spike, naydra's horn, naydra's claw, shard of naydra's fang.

Queen Gibdo is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The ruler of the Gibdos and the culprit behind the sand shroud that plagued the Gerudo region, the Queen Gibdo is an agile beast who built a nest in the desert to spawn her drones en masse. Her tough exoskeleton deflects ordinary weapons. It can be found in: Lightning Temple.

Igneo Talus is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This enormous monster is naturally camouflaged as molten rock. Neither sword nor arrow can pierce its fiery form. Merely touching its magma-hot body can burn you pretty badly, but you may be able to scale it if you can use something to chill its flames. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Eldin Canyon Depths. It drops: amber, ruby, flint, diamond.

Frox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A large monster that dwells in the Depths. Despite its unwieldy body, it has incredibly powerful legs that it can use to leap from afar to capture prey. Its large mouth allows it to swallow whatever it hungers for in one gulp. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands Depths, Central Hyrule Depths. It drops: large crystallized charge, frox fang, frox fingernail, frox guts, zonaite, large zonaite.

Colgera is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The culprit behind the blizzard that plagued the Hebra region. This huge beast harnesses wind to produce strong updrafts and lift itself aloft. The jagged layer of ice covering its body serves as a protective shield and allows it to launch frozen spikes at its foes. It can be found in: Wind Temple.

Demon King Ganondorf is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An evil man who lived long ago in the era of Hyrule's founding. He was imprisoned beneath Hyrule Castle for ages, but the magic weakened, and his power has steadily been growing since. Now he has revived as a threat beyond the knowledge of any. A master of every known weapon, he will not hesitate to crush any foe who stands in his way.

Frost Pebblit is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A very young Frost Talus. Their bodies toughen and frost over as they mature, becoming entirely made of ice by adulthood. As a child, however, their bodies are awfully fragile and are light enough to be blown away by a bomb's blast. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains. It drops: amber, sapphire, flint.

Stone Talus (Rare) is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This enormous monster is naturally camouflaged as a rock formation. Neither sword nor arrow can pierce its stony form, but a cunning adventurer knows to scale its body and attack the ore sprouting from its peak. Unlike your average Stone Talus, this type's ore deposit contains a large amount of precious ore, making it a rare find. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Faron Grasslands. It drops: ruby, diamond, sapphire, opal, topaz, amber, flint.

Yiga Footsoldier is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The lowest-ranked members of the Yiga Clan. They've been dispatched all across Hyrule with a single task: seek out and kill Princess Zelda and Link. They're a crafty bunch, sometimes disguising themselves as simple travelers or villagers to get the jump on you. Be wary of suspicious people you encounter. They're very agile, and their weapons of choice are bows and swords. It drops: eightfold blade, mighty bananas, green rupee, blue rupee, red rupee, purple rupee.

Captain Construct Iii is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An elite Soldier Construct, hence its "captain" title. Made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. A powerful Captain Construct. It has high durability and extremely advanced combat patterns. Equipped with a variety of sword techniques. It can be found in: Thyphlo Ruins. It drops: zonai charge, captain construct iii horn.

Igneo Pebblit is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A very young Igneo Talus. Their bodies toughen as they mature and convert fully into lava by adulthood. As a child, however, while still covered in fire, their bodies are fragile and light enough to be blown away by a bomb's blast. It can be found in: Eldin Canyon, Eldin Canyon Depths. It drops: amber.

Stone Talus is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This enormous monster is naturally camouflaged as a rock formation. Neither sword nor arrow can pierce its stony form, but a cunning adventurer knows to scale its body and attack the ore sprouting from its peak. Lives not only in meadows and rocky areas but also plains. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands Depths, Tabantha Frontier. It drops: ruby, amber, opal, flint.

Stone Talus (Luminous) is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This enormous monster is naturally camouflaged as a rock formation. Neither sword nor arrow can pierce its stony form, but a cunning adventurer knows to scale its body and attack the ore sprouting from its peak. Stronger than your average Stone Talus, and unlike that creature, its ore deposit consists mostly of luminous stone. It can be found in: Tabantha Frontier, Lanayru Great Spring. It drops: diamond, topaz, opal, amber, luminous stone, flint.

Frost Talus is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This enormous monster is naturally camouflaged as a frozen rock formation. Neither sword nor arrow can pierce its frigid form. Merely touching its frosty body can leave you with severe frostbite, but you may be able to scale it if you use something to thaw its icy exterior. Lives in cold, snowy regions. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains. It drops: diamond, sapphire, opal, flint.

Blue Hinox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These giant, one-eyed monsters live mostly in the woods, have giant horns, and possess a ferocity similar to that of their red brethren. They are also known for tearing entire trees from the ground and using them as weapons. They're stronger, though, and wear greaves that can be burnt away to expose their feet. A deft hand can steal weapons from the necklaces they wear. It can be found in: East Necluda Depths, West Necluda. It drops: hinox tooth, hinox toenail, blue hinox horn, hinox guts, roasted bass, roasted hearty bass, roasted trout, roasted hearty salmon, roasted carp, roasted porgy, sneaky river escargot, blackened crab.

Molduga is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This massive monster swims beneath the desert's sand. It spends most of its time submerged, but if it senses sound, it will breach the surface to feast on whatever it can grab. Running around carelessly can be dangerous if you suspect there may be one in the area. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert. It drops: molduga guts, molduga fin, molduga jaw.

King Gleeok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This three-headed monster with lightning, fire, and ice attributes first appeared after the Upheaval. Fighting it alone is inadvisable, as it can launch coordinated elemental attacks with staggering brutality. You must be well-prepared to survive an entanglement with this beast. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert Sky, Necluda Sea Sky. It drops: gleeok frost horn, gleeok thunder horn, gleeok flame horn, gleeok wing, gleeok guts.

Little Frox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A very young Frox. Makes up for its diminutive size with powerful legs and by attacking in large numbers. It can be found in: The Depths. It drops: giant brightbloom seed, zonaite, brightbloom seed.

Obsidian Frox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A large monster that dwells in the Depths. Has legs even more powerful than those of its green-colored counterpart, and it can leap from afar to capture distant enemies. Its large mouth allows it to swallow whatever it hungers for in one gulp. It can be found in: Gerudo Desert Depths, Hyrule Ridge Depths. It drops: large crystallized charge, obsidian frox fang, frox fingernail, frox guts, zonaite, large zonaite.

Mucktorok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The culprit behind the sludge that plagued Zora's Domain. Despite its small size, it was able to produce a massive deluge of the substance, polluting the entire region. It can mold sludge into outer shells of various shapes, a technique it uses both to protect itself and attack its foes. It can be found in: Water Temple.

Captain Construct Iv is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. An elite Soldier Construct, hence its "captain" title. Made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. Stands above all of its peers, as signified by its golden body. In endurance and sheer combat ability, it exceeds all other Captain Constructs, making it the mightiest of all. It drops: captain construct iv horn, zonai charge.

Flux Construct I is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A construct composed of interconnected blocks, made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. It can rearrange the blocks to change its shape at will. To provide sufficient energy to power its gigantic form, this construct contains a massive store of Zonai charge. It can be found in: West Hebra Sky Archipelago, Gerudo Highlands Depths. It drops: zonai charge, large zonai charge.

Flux Construct Iii is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A construct composed of interconnected blocks, made by the Zonai with advanced techniques and magic. This model has increased defenses to protect its vulnerable core. Can change shape in order to block attacks. To provide sufficient energy to power its gigantic form, this construct contains a massive store of Zonai charge. It can be found in: North Akkala Sky Archipelago. It drops: zonai charge, large zonai charge.

Hinox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These giant, one-eyed monsters live mostly in the woods and have large, thick horns. Hinox are known for tearing entire trees from the ground and using them as weapons. Occasionally, they fall asleep on roads, presenting terrifying roadblocks for travelers. A deft hand can steal weapons from the necklaces they wear. It can be found in: Hyrule Ridge, West Necluda. It drops: hinox toenail, hinox tooth, hinox guts, hinox horn, palm fruit, apple, wildberry, mighty banana, fortified pumpkin, voltfruit.

Frost Gleeok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This three-headed monster first appeared after the Upheaval. Fighting it alone is inadvisable, as its three heads will attack you all at once. Creates blistering cold air within its body. When someone sets foot upon its turf, this beast will freeze the intruder and their surroundings in ice. It can be found in: Gerudo Highlands, Hebra Mountains. It drops: gleeok frost horn, gleeok guts, gleeok wing.

Thunder Gleeok is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. This three-headed monster first appeared after the Upheaval. Fighting it alone is inadvisable, as its three heads will attack you all at once. When someone sets foot upon its turf, this beast will unleash a salvo of lightning strikes, not letting up until the intruder is reduced to a pile of ashes. It can be found in: Hyrule Field, Faron Grasslands. It drops: gleeok wing, gleeok thunder horn, gleeok guts.

Farosh is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A spirit of lightning has taken the form of this giant dragon. Making its home in the Faron region, it's said to have served the Spring of Courage since ancient times. The electricity that coats its body can cause lightning storms, but Farosh bears no ill will toward people. Few have seen it in the current age. It can be found in: Lake Hylia, Gerudo Canyon. It drops: shard of farosh's spike, farosh's claw, farosh's scale, shard of farosh's fang, farosh's horn.

Marbled Gohma is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The culprit behind marbled rock roast, who produced it and brought it to the Eldin region. It uses its rock-covered legs to execute devastating attacks. The eyeball on its head may look vulnerable, but good luck reaching it atop this creature's massive body. It can be found in: Fire Temple.

Seized Construct is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. The construct that Mineru originally intended to house her spirit. It was changed into this ominous form by the magic power of the Demon King. Originally intended for construction, it is highly durable and able to withstand harsh conditions. It can be found in: Spirit Temple.

Light Dragon is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A spirit has taken the form of this giant dragon inhabiting the upper reaches of the skies. It is named for its shining golden mane and gleaming scales. It looks divine as it soars through the sky, giving off a soft glow, and its presence is comforting somehow. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule.

Yiga Blademaster is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These are the elite soldiers of the Yiga Clan. Equipped with blades of wind-cleaving power, they are extremely agile despite their bulky build. At this Yiga Clan rank, they have mastered a technique that allows them to manipulate the very earth. By striking the ground, they can raise stone pillars and unleash a blast of air. It drops: eightfold longblade, mighty bananas, green rupee, blue rupee, red rupee, purple rupee.

Stone Pebblit is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A very young Stone Talus. Their bodies toughen as they mature, becoming as tough as boulders by adulthood. As a child, however, their bodies are light enough to be lifted and fragile enough to break when thrown. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule. It drops: flint, amber.

Blue-White Frox is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. A large monster that dwells in the Depths. Has ore on its back to lure enemies. Can shake off enemies who climb atop it and then snatch them midair. Its large mouth allows it to swallow whatever it hungers for in one gulp. It can be found in: Hebra Mountains Depths, Tabantha Frontier Depths. It drops: large crystallized charge, blue-white frox fang, frox fingernail, frox guts, zonaite, large zonaite.

Sludge Like is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. These sludge-loving Like Likes are nightmarishly mobile. They ooze sludge, and they use that sludge to move around, sometimes creeping into areas that other types of Like Likes tend to avoid. As if that weren't enough, they also spew sludge out of their maws to slow and capture prey. It can be found in: Lanayru Great Spring.

Phantom Ganon is a Monster in Tears of the Kingdom. Though it may walk on two legs, this creature is undeniably monstrous in appearance. A sinister aura permeates the air around it. You know little of its attributes or behavior, but its strength and weapon mastery make it a formidable foe. It was first sighted after the Upheaval. Its identity and origins are shrouded in mystery. It drops: dark clump.

Zonaite Deposit is a Treasure in Tears of the Kingdom. The deposit glows with mysterious energy and is very common in the Depths. If you crack it open, you can claim the zonaite within. It can be found in: The Depths. It drops: zonaite, large zonaite.

Treasure Chest is a Treasure in Tears of the Kingdom. Fortunes untold (potentially) await the lucky adventurer who finds one of these. Chests can often be found within shrines or at enemy camps, but there may be some crafty folks who think they're safer underground. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule. It drops: treasures.

Ore Deposit is a Treasure in Tears of the Kingdom. This deposit contains a good deal of ore. Breaking the rock will yield rock salt, flint, and other minerals of varying value. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule. It drops: ruby, diamond, amber, sapphire, topaz, opal, rock salt, flint.

Rare Ore Deposit is a Treasure in Tears of the Kingdom. This deposit contains a good deal of precious ore and the occasional rare mineral, like ruby and sapphire. Break it open to see what it has to offer! It can be found in: Greater Hyrule. It drops: ruby, sapphire, diamond, amber, topaz, flint.

Well is a Treasure in Tears of the Kingdom. A hole dug in the earth to draw water from underground. Can be found in stables, towns, and sometimes even ruins. Home to a variety of unique fauna and flora. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule. It drops: materials.

Luminous Stone Deposit is a Treasure in Tears of the Kingdom. This deposit contains quite a bit of luminous stone. Crack it open to get at the easily process rocks within. It can be found in: Greater Hyrule. It drops: luminous, flint.
